#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_NODES 16

struct node {
    unsigned int id, cookie, owner, published, tx_refs, slot_refs;
    int allocated;
};

struct registry {
    struct node nodes[MAX_NODES];
    unsigned int next_id, allocations, frees;
};

enum kind { COUNTER, ADDER };
struct local_object {
    unsigned int node, cookie, active;
    enum kind kind;
    int value, alive;
};

enum state { NONE, QUEUED, DELIVERED, REPLIED, FAILED };
enum request_owner { NO_REQUEST, DRIVER, SERVER };
enum event {
    PUBLISH, PUBLISH_FAULT, REMOVE, WRONG_REMOVE, CALL, CALL_FAULT,
    CALL_STALE, DELIVER, RECEIVE_FAULT, REPLY, CANCEL, REAP,
    FREE_REQUEST, LOCAL_BEGIN, LOCAL_END, DESTROY, OWNER_EXIT, EVENT_COUNT
};

static const char *const event_names[] = {
    "publish", "publish_fault", "remove", "wrong_remove", "call", "call_fault",
    "call_stale", "deliver", "receive_fault", "reply", "cancel", "reap",
    "free_request", "local_begin", "local_end", "destroy", "owner_exit"
};
static const char *const state_names[] = { "NONE", "QUEUED", "DELIVERED", "REPLIED", "FAILED" };
static const char *const request_names[] = { "NONE", "DRIVER", "SERVER" };

struct trace {
    struct registry registry;
    struct node *node;
    struct local_object object;
    enum state state;
    enum request_owner request;
    unsigned int tx_live, terminal_count, descriptor_node, descriptor_cookie;
    unsigned int tx_acquires, tx_releases, slot_acquires, slot_releases;
    int owner_alive, descriptor_claimed;
};

static unsigned int references(const struct node *node)
{
    return node->published + node->tx_refs + node->slot_refs;
}

static void collect(struct registry *registry, struct node *node)
{
    if (node->allocated && !references(node)) {
        node->allocated = 0;
        ++registry->frees;
    }
}

static struct node *find_id(struct registry *registry, unsigned int id)
{
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i)
        if (registry->nodes[i].allocated && registry->nodes[i].published &&
            registry->nodes[i].id == id)
            return &registry->nodes[i];
    return NULL;
}

static struct node *publish(struct registry *registry, unsigned int owner,
                            unsigned int cookie, int *created)
{
    struct node *available = NULL;

    *created = 0;
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) {
        struct node *node = &registry->nodes[i];
        if (node->allocated && node->published && node->owner == owner && node->cookie == cookie)
            return node;
        if (!node->allocated && !available)
            available = node;
    }
    if (!cookie || !available)
        return NULL;
    *available = (struct node){ .id = ++registry->next_id, .cookie = cookie,
                               .owner = owner, .published = 1, .allocated = 1 };
    ++registry->allocations;
    *created = 1;
    return available;
}

static const char *remove_node(struct registry *registry, unsigned int owner, unsigned int id)
{
    struct node *node = find_id(registry, id);

    if (!node)
        return "ENOENT";
    if (node->owner != owner)
        return "EPERM";
    if (references(node) != 1)
        return "EBUSY";
    node->published = 0;
    collect(registry, node);
    return "OK";
}

static void require(int condition, const char *message)
{
    if (!condition) {
        fprintf(stderr, "node invariant failed: %s\n", message);
        exit(1);
    }
}

static int is_terminal(enum state state)
{
    return state == REPLIED || state == FAILED;
}

static void free_request(struct trace *trace)
{
    require(trace->request != NO_REQUEST && trace->node->slot_refs == 1, "request owner");
    trace->request = NO_REQUEST;
    --trace->node->slot_refs;
    ++trace->slot_releases;
    collect(&trace->registry, trace->node);
}

static void check_trace(const struct trace *trace)
{
    const struct node *node = trace->node;

    require(trace->registry.allocations - trace->registry.frees == (unsigned int)node->allocated,
            "node allocation ledger");
    require((unsigned int)node->allocated == (unsigned int)(references(node) != 0), "node refs");
    require(node->tx_refs == trace->tx_live && trace->tx_live <= 1, "transaction refs");
    require(node->slot_refs == (unsigned int)(trace->request != NO_REQUEST), "slot refs");
    require(trace->tx_acquires - trace->tx_releases == node->tx_refs, "transaction releases");
    require(trace->slot_acquires - trace->slot_releases == node->slot_refs, "slot releases");
    require(trace->terminal_count == (unsigned int)is_terminal(trace->state), "terminal once");
    require(trace->request != DRIVER || trace->state == QUEUED, "queued slot");
    require(trace->request != SERVER || trace->state != QUEUED, "delivered slot");
    require(trace->object.alive || !trace->object.active, "local object lifetime");
    require(trace->owner_alive || (!node->published && !node->slot_refs && !trace->object.alive),
            "owner exit cleanup");
}

static const char *start_call(struct trace *trace, unsigned int target, int fault)
{
    struct node *node = find_id(&trace->registry, target);

    if (!node || !trace->owner_alive)
        return "ENOENT";
    /* A trace observes one request at a time, not the driver's whole queue. */
    if (trace->tx_live || trace->request != NO_REQUEST)
        return "EBUSY";
    ++node->slot_refs;
    ++trace->slot_acquires;
    trace->request = DRIVER;
    if (fault) {
        free_request(trace);
        return "EFAULT";
    }
    ++node->tx_refs;
    ++trace->tx_acquires;
    trace->tx_live = 1;
    trace->state = QUEUED;
    trace->terminal_count = 0;
    return "OK";
}

static void observe(const struct trace *trace, const char *operation, const char *status, int created)
{
    const struct node *node = trace->node;

    printf("event=step operation=%s status=%s accepted=%d created=%d node=%u cookie=%u "
           "published=%u tx_refs=%u slot_refs=%u refs=%u live_nodes=%d "
           "state=%s tx_live=%u request=%s terminal_count=%u "
           "local_active=%u local_alive=%d owner_alive=%d "
           "node_allocs=%u node_frees=%u descriptor_node=%u "
           "tx_acquires=%u tx_releases=%u slot_acquires=%u slot_releases=%u\n",
           operation, status, strcmp(status, "OK") == 0, created, node->id, node->cookie,
           node->published, node->tx_refs, node->slot_refs, references(node), node->allocated,
           state_names[trace->state], trace->tx_live, request_names[trace->request],
           trace->terminal_count, trace->object.active, trace->object.alive, trace->owner_alive,
           trace->registry.allocations, trace->registry.frees, trace->descriptor_node,
           trace->tx_acquires, trace->tx_releases, trace->slot_acquires, trace->slot_releases);
}

static void step(struct trace *trace, enum event event)
{
    const char *status = "OK";
    int created = 0;

    switch (event) {
    case PUBLISH:
    case PUBLISH_FAULT:
        if (!trace->owner_alive) {
            status = "EPIPE";
        } else if (!trace->node->published && trace->object.alive) {
            status = "EBUSY";
        } else {
            trace->node = publish(&trace->registry, 1, 7, &created);
            require(trace->node != NULL, "bounded trace publication");
            if (event == PUBLISH_FAULT) {
                if (created) {
                    trace->node->published = 0;
                    collect(&trace->registry, trace->node);
                }
                status = "EFAULT";
            } else if (created) {
                trace->object = (struct local_object){ .node = trace->node->id,
                    .cookie = 7, .kind = COUNTER, .alive = 1 };
            }
        }
        break;
    case REMOVE:
    case WRONG_REMOVE:
        status = remove_node(&trace->registry, event == REMOVE ? 1 : 2, trace->node->id);
        break;
    case CALL:
    case CALL_STALE:
    case CALL_FAULT:
        status = start_call(trace, event == CALL_STALE ? 101 : trace->node->id, event == CALL_FAULT);
        break;
    case DELIVER:
    case RECEIVE_FAULT:
        if (!trace->tx_live || trace->state != QUEUED) {
            status = "ENOENT";
        } else if (event == RECEIVE_FAULT) {
            status = "EFAULT";
        } else {
            trace->state = DELIVERED;
            trace->request = SERVER;
            trace->descriptor_node = trace->node->id;
            trace->descriptor_cookie = trace->node->cookie;
            trace->descriptor_claimed = 0;
        }
        break;
    case REPLY:
        if (!trace->tx_live || trace->state != DELIVERED) {
            status = "ENOENT";
        } else {
            trace->state = REPLIED;
            ++trace->terminal_count;
        }
        break;
    case CANCEL:
        if (!trace->tx_live || is_terminal(trace->state)) {
            status = "ENOENT";
        } else {
            if (trace->state == QUEUED)
                free_request(trace);
            trace->state = FAILED;
            ++trace->terminal_count;
        }
        break;
    case REAP:
        if (!trace->tx_live || !is_terminal(trace->state)) {
            status = "ENOENT";
        } else {
            trace->tx_live = 0;
            --trace->node->tx_refs;
            ++trace->tx_releases;
            collect(&trace->registry, trace->node);
        }
        break;
    case FREE_REQUEST:
        if (trace->request != SERVER)
            status = trace->request == DRIVER ? "EBUSY" : "ENOENT";
        else
            free_request(trace);
        break;
    case LOCAL_BEGIN:
        if (!trace->descriptor_node || !trace->object.alive ||
            trace->object.node != trace->descriptor_node ||
            trace->object.cookie != trace->descriptor_cookie) {
            status = "ESTALE";
        } else if (trace->descriptor_claimed || trace->request != SERVER) {
            status = "EBUSY";
        } else {
            ++trace->object.active;
            trace->descriptor_claimed = 1;
        }
        break;
    case LOCAL_END:
        if (!trace->object.active)
            status = "ENOENT";
        else
            --trace->object.active;
        break;
    case DESTROY:
        if (!trace->object.alive)
            status = "ENOENT";
        else if (trace->node->published || trace->object.active)
            status = "EBUSY";
        else
            trace->object.alive = 0;
        break;
    case OWNER_EXIT:
        if (!trace->owner_alive) {
            status = "EPIPE";
        } else {
            trace->owner_alive = 0;
            if (trace->tx_live && !is_terminal(trace->state)) {
                trace->state = FAILED;
                ++trace->terminal_count;
            }
            if (trace->request != NO_REQUEST)
                free_request(trace);
            trace->node->published = 0;
            trace->node->owner = 0;
            trace->object.alive = 0;
            trace->object.active = 0;
            collect(&trace->registry, trace->node);
        }
        break;
    case EVENT_COUNT:
        require(0, "invalid event");
        break;
    }
    check_trace(trace);
    observe(trace, event_names[event], status, created);
}

static void run_trace(int count, char **events)
{
    struct trace trace = { .registry.next_id = 100, .owner_alive = 1 };
    int created;

    trace.node = publish(&trace.registry, 1, 7, &created);
    trace.object = (struct local_object){ .node = trace.node->id, .cookie = 7,
                                          .kind = COUNTER, .alive = 1 };
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < EVENT_COUNT; ++j)
            if (strcmp(events[i], event_names[j]) == 0) {
                step(&trace, (enum event)j);
                break;
            }
    printf("event=summary live_nodes=%d published=%u tx_refs=%u slot_refs=%u local_active=%u\n",
           trace.node->allocated, trace.node->published, trace.node->tx_refs,
           trace.node->slot_refs, trace.object.active);
}

static void method_counterexample(void)
{
    const char *const objects[] = { "A", "B", "A" };
    const int expected[] = { 1, 1, 2 };
    int shared_counter = 0;

    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        ++shared_counter;
        printf("event=method_call object=%s code=1 expected=%d observed=%d\n",
               objects[i], expected[i], shared_counter);
    }
    require(shared_counter != expected[2], "method-only counterexample");
}

static const char *dispatch(struct registry *registry, struct local_object *objects,
                            unsigned int target, unsigned int code, int a, int b, int *value)
{
    struct node *node = find_id(registry, target);

    if (!node)
        return "ENOENT";
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        struct local_object *object = &objects[i];
        if (!object->alive || object->node != node->id || object->cookie != node->cookie)
            continue;
        ++object->active;
        if (object->kind == COUNTER && code == 1) {
            object->value += a;
            *value = object->value;
        } else if (object->kind == COUNTER && code == 2) {
            *value = object->value;
        } else if (object->kind == ADDER && code == 3) {
            *value = a + b;
        } else {
            --object->active;
            return "ENOSYS";
        }
        --object->active;
        return "OK";
    }
    return "ESTALE";
}

static void registry_demo(void)
{
    struct registry registry = { .next_id = 100 };
    struct local_object objects[3] = { 0 };
    const unsigned int cookies[] = { 11, 22, 33, 11 };
    const unsigned int targets[] = { 101, 102, 101, 102, 103, 101 };
    const unsigned int codes[] = { 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 999 };
    const int arguments[] = { 1, 1, 2, 0, 19, 0 };
    const int expected[] = { 1, 101, 3, 101, 42, 0 };

    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
        int created;
        struct node *node = publish(&registry, 1, cookies[i], &created);
        require(node != NULL, "registry publication");
        printf("event=publish owner=1 cookie=%u node=%u created=%d\n", cookies[i], node->id, created);
        if (created)
            objects[i] = (struct local_object){ .node = node->id, .cookie = cookies[i],
                .kind = i == 2 ? ADDER : COUNTER, .value = i == 1 ? 100 : 0, .alive = 1 };
    }
    require(registry.allocations == 3, "publication deduplication");
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
        int value = 0;
        const char *status = dispatch(&registry, objects, targets[i], codes[i], arguments[i], 23, &value);
        require(strcmp(status, i == 5 ? "ENOSYS" : "OK") == 0, "user dispatch status");
        require(i == 5 || value == expected[i], "user dispatch value");
        printf("event=result node=%u code=%u status=%s value=", targets[i], codes[i], status);
        if (strcmp(status, "OK") == 0)
            printf("%d\n", value);
        else
            puts("none");
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        require(strcmp(remove_node(&registry, 1, objects[i].node), "OK") == 0, "registry removal");
        require(!objects[i].active, "local dispatch released");
        objects[i].alive = 0;
    }
    require(registry.allocations == registry.frees, "registry cleanup");
    puts("event=summary live_nodes=0 published=0 local_active=0");
}

static int known_event(const char *name)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < EVENT_COUNT; ++i)
        if (strcmp(name, event_names[i]) == 0)
            return 1;
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "method") == 0) {
        method_counterexample();
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 2 && strcmp(argv[1], "registry") == 0) {
        registry_demo();
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc >= 3 && strcmp(argv[1], "trace") == 0) {
        for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i)
            if (!known_event(argv[i]))
                goto usage;
        run_trace(argc - 2, argv + 2);
        return 0;
    }
usage:
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: nodes method | registry | trace EVENT...\n");
    return 2;
}

仓库路径：examples/models/parcel.c。源文本 SHA-256：d0fa2d182c1020b66435b8970a11cb17d5bbe7aa0e137cb3a2929d619b3383d8。

#include <errno.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "parcel.h"

#define PAYLOAD_LIMIT MBP_MAX_BYTES
#define VALUE_LIMIT (PAYLOAD_LIMIT / 4)
struct message {
    uint32_t sequence;
    int32_t status;
    int label_is_null;
    const unsigned char *label;
    size_t label_size;
    int32_t values[VALUE_LIMIT];
    size_t value_count;
};

static int fail(const char **error, const char *reason)
{
    *error = reason;
    return 0;
}

static int encode(struct mbp_writer *writer, const struct message *message,
                  const char **error)
{
    struct mbp_writer next = *writer;
    if (!mbp_write_u32(&next, message->sequence, error) ||
        !mbp_write_i32(&next, message->status, error) ||
        !mbp_write_bytes(&next, message->label, message->label_size,
                         message->label_is_null, error) ||
        !mbp_write_array(&next, message->values, message->value_count, error))
        return 0;
    *writer = next;
    return 1;
}

static int decode(struct mbp_reader *reader, struct message *message, const char **error)
{
    struct mbp_reader next = *reader;
    struct message result = {0};
    if (!mbp_read_u32(&next, &result.sequence, error) ||
        !mbp_read_i32(&next, &result.status, error) ||
        !mbp_read_bytes(&next, &result.label, &result.label_size, &result.label_is_null, error) ||
        !mbp_read_array(&next, result.values, VALUE_LIMIT, &result.value_count, error) ||
        !mbp_reader_finish(&next, error))
        return 0;
    *message = result;
    *reader = next;
    return 1;
}

static int hex_digit(char character)
{
    if (character >= '0' && character <= '9')
        return character - '0';
    if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'f')
        return character - 'a' + 10;
    if (character >= 'A' && character <= 'F')
        return character - 'A' + 10;
    return -1;
}

static int parse_hex(const char *text, unsigned char *bytes, size_t *size,
                     const char **error)
{
    size_t characters = strlen(text);
    if (characters % 2)
        return fail(error, "hex");
    if (characters / 2 > PAYLOAD_LIMIT)
        return fail(error, "limit");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < characters / 2; ++i) {
        int high = hex_digit(text[i * 2]), low = hex_digit(text[i * 2 + 1]);
        if (high < 0 || low < 0)
            return fail(error, "hex");
        bytes[i] = (unsigned char)(high * 16 + low);
    }
    *size = characters / 2;
    return 1;
}

static int parse_u32(const char *text, uint32_t *value, const char **error)
{
    uintmax_t parsed;
    char *end;
    if (*text < '0' || *text > '9')
        return fail(error, "number");
    errno = 0;
    parsed = strtoumax(text, &end, 10);
    if (errno || *end || parsed > UINT32_MAX)
        return fail(error, "number");
    *value = (uint32_t)parsed;
    return 1;
}

static int parse_i32(const char *text, const char **end, int32_t *value,
                     const char **error)
{
    const char *digits = text + (*text == '-');
    char *after;
    intmax_t parsed;
    if (*digits < '0' || *digits > '9')
        return fail(error, "number");
    errno = 0;
    parsed = strtoimax(text, &after, 10);
    if (errno || parsed < INT32_MIN || parsed > INT32_MAX)
        return fail(error, "number");
    *value = (int32_t)parsed;
    *end = after;
    return 1;
}

static int parse_values(const char *text, struct message *message, const char **error)
{
    size_t count = 0;
    while (*text) {
        const char *after;
        if (count >= VALUE_LIMIT)
            return fail(error, "limit");
        if (!parse_i32(text, &after, &message->values[count], error))
            return 0;
        ++count;
        if (!*after)
            break;
        if (*after != ',' || !after[1])
            return fail(error, "number");
        text = after + 1;
    }
    message->value_count = count;
    return 1;
}

static void print_hex(const unsigned char *data, size_t size)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
        printf("%02x", (unsigned int)data[i]);
}

static void print_message(const struct message *message)
{
    printf("sequence=%" PRIu32 "\nstatus=%" PRId32 "\nlabel=",
           message->sequence, message->status);
    if (message->label_is_null)
        printf("null");
    else
        print_hex(message->label, message->label_size);
    printf("\nvalues=");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < message->value_count; ++i)
        printf("%s%" PRId32, i ? "," : "", message->values[i]);
    putchar('\n');
}

static int selftest(const char **error)
{
    unsigned char buffer[64] = {0};
    unsigned char payload[] = {1, 2, 3};
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    struct message message = {0};
    uint32_t value;
    int32_t values[2] = {1, -2};
    size_t size, count;
    const unsigned char *bytes;
    int null;

    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, 11, error) ||
        !mbp_reader_init(&reader, buffer, 11, error) ||
        mbp_write_u32(&writer, 1, error) || writer.position != 8 ||
        mbp_read_u32(&reader, &value, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, sizeof(buffer), error) ||
        mbp_write_bytes(&writer, payload, SIZE_MAX, 0, error) || writer.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_write_u32(&writer, 3, error) ||
        !mbp_reader_init(&reader, buffer, 14, error) ||
        mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &bytes, &size, &null, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, sizeof(buffer), error) ||
        mbp_write_array(&writer, values, SIZE_MAX, error) || writer.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_write_u32(&writer, 2, error) ||
        !mbp_reader_init(&reader, buffer, 16, error) ||
        mbp_read_array(&reader, values, 2, &count, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, 20, error) ||
        encode(&writer, &message, error) || writer.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    buffer[4] = 2;
    if (mbp_reader_init(&reader, buffer, 16, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, sizeof(buffer), error) ||
        !mbp_write_bytes(&writer, payload, 3, 0, error))
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    buffer[15] = 1;
    if (!mbp_reader_init(&reader, buffer, 16, error) ||
        mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &bytes, &size, &null, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    memset(buffer + 8, 0xff, 4);
    if (mbp_read_array(&reader, values, 2, &count, error) || reader.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, buffer, sizeof(buffer), error) ||
        mbp_write_bytes(&writer, payload, SIZE_MAX, 0, error) || strcmp(*error, "overflow") ||
        mbp_write_bytes(&writer, payload, SIZE_MAX - 1, 0, error) || strcmp(*error, "overflow") ||
        mbp_write_array(&writer, values, SIZE_MAX, error) || strcmp(*error, "overflow") ||
        mbp_write_array(&writer, values, SIZE_MAX / 4 + 1, error) || strcmp(*error, "overflow") ||
        writer.position != 8)
        return fail(error, "selftest");
    puts("cursor_checks=10\noverflow_checks=4");
    return 1;
}

static int raw_example(const char **error)
{
    struct raw_message {
        const unsigned char *label;
        size_t label_size;
        const int32_t *values;
        size_t value_count;
    };
    unsigned char label[] = {'A', 0, 'B'}, before[sizeof(label)], wire[64];
    int32_t values[] = {1, -2};
    struct raw_message original = {label, sizeof(label), values, 2}, copied;
    struct message message = {0}, decoded;
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    size_t wire_size;

    memcpy(&copied, &original, sizeof(copied));
    memcpy(before, copied.label, sizeof(before));
    message.label = copied.label;
    message.label_size = copied.label_size;
    message.value_count = copied.value_count;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < copied.value_count; ++i)
        message.values[i] = copied.values[i];
    if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), error) ||
        !encode(&writer, &message, error) || !mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &wire_size, error))
        return 0;
    label[0] = 'Z';
    values[0] = 99;
    if (!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, wire_size, error) ||
        !decode(&reader, &decoded, error))
        return 0;
    printf("same_label_pointer=%d\nsame_array_pointer=%d\nraw_label_before=",
           copied.label == original.label, copied.values == original.values);
    print_hex(before, sizeof(before));
    printf("\nraw_label_after=");
    print_hex(copied.label, copied.label_size);
    printf("\nraw_array_after=%" PRId32 ",%" PRId32 "\nwire_label=",
           copied.values[0], copied.values[1]);
    print_hex(decoded.label, decoded.label_size);
    printf("\nwire_values=");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < decoded.value_count; ++i)
        printf("%s%" PRId32, i ? "," : "", decoded.values[i]);
    putchar('\n');
    return 1;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    unsigned char wire[PAYLOAD_LIMIT], label[PAYLOAD_LIMIT];
    struct message message = {0};
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    size_t wire_size;
    const char *error = "input";

    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "raw")) {
        if (!raw_example(&error))
            goto failure;
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "selftest")) {
        if (!selftest(&error))
            goto failure;
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "decode")) {
        if (!parse_hex(argv[2], wire, &wire_size, &error) ||
            !mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, wire_size, &error) ||
            !decode(&reader, &message, &error))
            goto failure;
        print_message(&message);
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 6 && !strcmp(argv[1], "encode")) {
        const char *after;
        if (!parse_u32(argv[2], &message.sequence, &error) ||
            !parse_i32(argv[3], &after, &message.status, &error))
            goto failure;
        if (*after) {
            error = "number";
            goto failure;
        }
        message.label_is_null = !strcmp(argv[4], "null");
        if (!message.label_is_null &&
            !parse_hex(argv[4], label, &message.label_size, &error))
            goto failure;
        message.label = label;
        if (!parse_values(argv[5], &message, &error) ||
            !mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error) ||
            !encode(&writer, &message, &error) ||
            !mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &wire_size, &error))
            goto failure;
        printf("hex=");
        print_hex(wire, wire_size);
        putchar('\n');
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 1 || (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "demo"))) {
        static const unsigned char sample[] = {'A', 0, 'B'};
        struct message decoded;
        message.sequence = UINT32_C(0x12345678);
        message.status = -7;
        message.label = sample;
        message.label_size = sizeof(sample);
        message.values[0] = 1;
        message.values[1] = -2;
        message.values[2] = INT32_MAX;
        message.values[3] = INT32_MIN;
        message.value_count = 4;
        if (!mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error) ||
            !encode(&writer, &message, &error) ||
            !mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &wire_size, &error))
            goto failure;
        if (!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, wire_size, &error) ||
            !decode(&reader, &decoded, &error))
            goto failure;
        printf("hex=");
        print_hex(wire, wire_size);
        putchar('\n');
        print_message(&decoded);
        return 0;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s raw | demo | encode U32 I32 null-or-HEX CSV | decode HEX | selftest\n",
            argv[0]);
    return 2;

failure:
    fprintf(stderr, "error=%s\n", error);
    return 1;
}

#include <limits.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define CONTEXTS 3
#define NODES 3
#define MAX_REFS 32
#define MAX_SLOTS 16
#define MAX_OBJECTS 16

enum object_type { LOCAL = 1, HANDLE = 2 };
enum slot_kind { GRANT, REQUEST, RESPONSE };
enum tx_state { NONE, QUEUED, DELIVERED, REPLIED, FAILED };

struct node {
    unsigned int id, cookie, published, transactions, target_slots, refs, local;
    int owner, allocated, value;
};
struct ref {
    struct node *node;
    unsigned int handle;
    uint32_t user, buffer;
};
struct hold {
    enum object_type type;
    struct node *node;
    struct ref *ref;
};
struct slot {
    unsigned int token, delivered, count;
    enum slot_kind kind;
    struct node *target;
    struct hold holds[MAX_OBJECTS];
};
struct context {
    int alive, mapped;
    struct ref refs[MAX_REFS];
    struct slot slots[MAX_SLOTS];
};
struct object { unsigned int type, value, cookie; };
struct transaction {
    enum tx_state state;
    int live;
    struct node *target;
    unsigned int request, reply;
};
struct model {
    struct node nodes[NODES];
    struct context contexts[CONTEXTS];
    struct transaction tx;
    unsigned int next_token, allocations, frees, xgrant, zgrant, owner_grant;
    unsigned int xhandle, converted, rolled_back, observed_node;
    int observed_value, has_value;
};
struct totals {
    unsigned int nodes, refs, slots, pending, buffers, locals;
    uint64_t users;
};

static const char *const context_names[] = { "A", "B", "C" };
static const char *const state_names[] = { "NONE", "QUEUED", "DELIVERED", "REPLIED", "FAILED" };
static const char *const kind_names[] = { "GRANT", "REQUEST", "REPLY" };
static const char *const operations[] = {
    "send_x", "send_twice", "send_max", "send_bad", "send_bad_twice", "send_fault",
    "send_unknown", "forge_local", "wrong_cookie", "forged_handle", "wrong_import",
    "import_x", "import_fault", "acquire_x", "release_x", "free_x", "use_x", "stale_x",
    "return_owner", "import_owner", "free_owner", "send_z", "import_z", "free_z",
    "call", "deliver", "receive_fault", "cancel", "reap", "free_request",
    "reply", "reply_object", "reply_fault", "return_reply", "call_output_fault", "free_reply",
    "close_a", "close_b", "close_c", "unmap_c", "remap_c"
};

static void require(int condition, const char *message)
{
    if (!condition) {
        fprintf(stderr, "reference invariant failed: %s\n", message);
        exit(1);
    }
}

static void collect(struct model *model, struct node *node)
{
    if (node->allocated && !node->published && !node->transactions &&
        !node->target_slots && !node->refs && !node->local) {
        node->allocated = 0;
        ++model->frees;
    }
}

static struct ref *find_ref(struct context *context, unsigned int handle)
{
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_REFS; ++i)
        if (context->refs[i].node && context->refs[i].handle == handle)
            return &context->refs[i];
    return NULL;
}

static void drop_ref(struct model *model, struct ref *ref)
{
    if (!ref->user && !ref->buffer) {
        struct node *node = ref->node;

        require(node && node->refs, "Ref entry owns Node");
        --node->refs;
        memset(ref, 0, sizeof(*ref));
        collect(model, node);
    }
}

static struct slot *find_slot(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                              unsigned int token)
{
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; ++i)
        if (token && model->contexts[context].slots[i].token == token)
            return &model->contexts[context].slots[i];
    return NULL;
}

static void destroy_slot(struct model *model, struct slot *slot, int rollback)
{
    while (slot->count) {
        struct hold *hold = &slot->holds[--slot->count];

        if (hold->type == HANDLE) {
            require(hold->ref->node == hold->node && hold->ref->buffer,
                    "slot owns precise buffer unit");
            --hold->ref->buffer;
            drop_ref(model, hold->ref);
        } else {
            require(hold->type == LOCAL && hold->node->local, "slot owns LOCAL unit");
            --hold->node->local;
            collect(model, hold->node);
        }
        if (rollback)
            ++model->rolled_back;
    }
    if (slot->target) {
        require(slot->target->target_slots != 0, "slot owns target unit");
        --slot->target->target_slots;
        collect(model, slot->target);
    }
    memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
}

static const char *reserve_slot(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                                 enum slot_kind kind, struct slot **out)
{
    struct context *recipient = &model->contexts[context];

    if (!recipient->alive)
        return "ENOENT";
    if (!recipient->mapped)
        return "ENXIO";
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; ++i) {
        struct slot *slot = &recipient->slots[i];

        if (slot->token)
            continue;
        if (model->next_token == UINT_MAX)
            return "EOVERFLOW";
        *slot = (struct slot){ .token = ++model->next_token, .kind = kind };
        *out = slot;
        return "OK";
    }
    return "EAGAIN";
}

static const char *source_node(struct model *model, unsigned int sender,
                                struct object object, struct node **out)
{
    struct node *node = NULL;

    if (object.type == HANDLE) {
        struct ref *ref = find_ref(&model->contexts[sender], object.value);

        if (!ref)
            return "EBADF";
        require(ref->user || ref->buffer, "live Ref has a unit");
        node = ref->node;
        if (node->owner < 0)
            return "EPIPE";
    } else {
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < NODES; ++i)
            if (model->nodes[i].allocated && model->nodes[i].id == object.value)
                node = &model->nodes[i];
        if (!node)
            return "ENOENT";
        if (node->owner != (int)sender)
            return "EPERM";
        if (node->cookie != object.cookie)
            return "EINVAL";
    }
    *out = node;
    return "OK";
}

static const char *convert_one(struct model *model, unsigned int sender,
                                unsigned int receiver, struct object object,
                                struct slot *slot)
{
    struct context *context = &model->contexts[receiver];
    struct node *node;
    struct hold *hold = &slot->holds[slot->count];
    const char *status = source_node(model, sender, object, &node);

    if (strcmp(status, "OK"))
        return status;
    if (node->owner == (int)receiver) {
        if (node->local == UINT_MAX)
            return "EOVERFLOW";
        ++node->local;
        *hold = (struct hold){ .type = LOCAL, .node = node };
    } else {
        struct ref *ref = NULL, *available = NULL;

        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_REFS; ++i) {
            if (context->refs[i].node == node)
                ref = &context->refs[i];
            if (!context->refs[i].node && !available)
                available = &context->refs[i];
        }
        if (!ref) {
            unsigned int handle = 1;

            if (!available)
                return "EAGAIN";
            if (node->refs == UINT_MAX)
                return "EOVERFLOW";
            while (find_ref(context, handle))
                ++handle;
            ref = available;
            *ref = (struct ref){ .node = node, .handle = handle };
            ++node->refs;
        }
        if (ref->buffer == UINT32_MAX)
            return "EOVERFLOW";
        ++ref->buffer;
        *hold = (struct hold){ .type = HANDLE, .node = node, .ref = ref };
    }
    ++slot->count;
    ++model->converted;
    return "OK";
}

static const char *parcel(struct model *model, unsigned int sender,
                           unsigned int receiver, const struct object *objects,
                           unsigned int count, enum slot_kind kind, int fault,
                           unsigned int *token)
{
    struct slot *slot;
    const char *status;

    if (!model->contexts[sender].alive)
        return "EBADF";
    if (count > MAX_OBJECTS)
        return "EINVAL";
    status = reserve_slot(model, receiver, kind, &slot);
    if (strcmp(status, "OK"))
        return status;
    /* Validate the complete logical object table before changing any Ref. */
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        if (objects[i].type != LOCAL && objects[i].type != HANDLE) {
            status = "EOPNOTSUPP";
            goto rollback;
        }
        if ((objects[i].type == HANDLE && objects[i].cookie) ||
            (objects[i].type == LOCAL && (!objects[i].value || !objects[i].cookie))) {
            status = "EINVAL";
            goto rollback;
        }
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        status = convert_one(model, sender, receiver, objects[i], slot);
        if (strcmp(status, "OK"))
            goto rollback;
    }
    if (fault) {
        status = "EFAULT";
        goto rollback;
    }
    *token = slot->token;
    return "OK";
rollback:
    destroy_slot(model, slot, 1);
    return status;
}

static const char *import_grant(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                                 unsigned int token, int fault)
{
    struct slot *slot = find_slot(model, context, token);

    if (!slot || slot->kind != GRANT || slot->delivered)
        return "ENOENT";
    if (!model->contexts[context].mapped)
        return "ENXIO";
    if (fault)
        return "EFAULT";
    slot->delivered = 1;
    return "OK";
}

static const char *free_buffer(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                                unsigned int token)
{
    struct slot *slot = find_slot(model, context, token);

    if (!slot)
        return "ENOENT";
    if (!slot->delivered)
        return "EBUSY";
    destroy_slot(model, slot, 0);
    return "OK";
}

static const char *user_ref(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                             unsigned int handle, int acquire)
{
    struct ref *ref = find_ref(&model->contexts[context], handle);

    if (!ref)
        return "EBADF";
    if (acquire) {
        if (ref->node->owner < 0)
            return "EPIPE";
        if (ref->user == UINT32_MAX)
            return "EOVERFLOW";
        ++ref->user;
    } else {
        if (!ref->user)
            return "EINVAL";
        --ref->user;
        drop_ref(model, ref);
    }
    return "OK";
}

static const char *dispatch(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                             unsigned int handle, unsigned int amount)
{
    struct ref *ref = find_ref(&model->contexts[context], handle);

    if (!ref)
        return "EBADF";
    model->observed_node = ref->node->id;
    if (ref->node->owner < 0)
        return "EPIPE";
    if (amount > (unsigned int)(INT_MAX - ref->node->value))
        return "EOVERFLOW";
    ref->node->value += (int)amount;
    model->observed_value = ref->node->value;
    model->has_value = 1;
    return "OK";
}

static int terminal(const struct transaction *tx)
{
    return tx->state == REPLIED || tx->state == FAILED;
}

static void finish(struct model *model, enum tx_state state)
{
    struct transaction *tx = &model->tx;

    require(tx->live && !terminal(tx), "transaction terminates once");
    if (tx->state == QUEUED) {
        struct slot *request = find_slot(model, 0, tx->request);

        require(request != NULL, "queued transaction owns request until cancellation");
        destroy_slot(model, request, 0);
    }
    tx->state = state;
}

static void reap(struct model *model)
{
    struct transaction *tx = &model->tx;

    require(tx->live && terminal(tx) && tx->target->transactions, "reap owns target");
    --tx->target->transactions;
    collect(model, tx->target);
    tx->live = 0;
}

static const char *begin_call(struct model *model)
{
    struct ref *ref = find_ref(&model->contexts[2], model->xhandle);
    struct object object = { HANDLE, model->xhandle, 0 };
    unsigned int token;
    struct slot *slot;
    const char *status;

    if (!ref)
        return "EBADF";
    model->observed_node = ref->node->id;
    if (ref->node->owner < 0)
        return "EPIPE";
    slot = find_slot(model, 2, model->tx.reply);
    if (model->tx.live || (slot && !slot->delivered))
        return "EBUSY";
    if (!model->contexts[2].mapped)
        return "ENXIO";
    status = parcel(model, 2, 0, &object, 1, REQUEST, 0, &token);
    if (strcmp(status, "OK"))
        return status;
    slot = find_slot(model, 0, token);
    slot->target = ref->node;
    ++ref->node->target_slots;
    ++ref->node->transactions;
    model->tx = (struct transaction){ .state = QUEUED, .live = 1,
        .target = ref->node, .request = token };
    return "OK";
}

static const char *reply(struct model *model, int with_object, int fault)
{
    struct transaction *tx = &model->tx;
    struct object object = { LOCAL, 102, 22 };
    const char *status;

    if (!tx->live || tx->state != DELIVERED)
        return "ENOENT";
    if (tx->target->value == INT_MAX)
        return "EOVERFLOW";
    if (with_object) {
        status = parcel(model, 0, 2, &object, 1, RESPONSE, fault, &tx->reply);
        if (strcmp(status, "OK"))
            return status;
    }
    model->observed_node = tx->target->id;
    model->observed_value = ++tx->target->value;
    model->has_value = 1;
    finish(model, REPLIED);
    return "OK";
}

static const char *close_context(struct model *model, unsigned int index)
{
    struct context *context = &model->contexts[index];

    if (!context->alive)
        return "ENOENT";
    if ((index == 0 || index == 2) && model->tx.live && !terminal(&model->tx))
        finish(model, FAILED);
    /* close_c represents process exit: cancellation/reap precede final close. */
    if (index == 2 && model->tx.live)
        reap(model);
    context->alive = 0;
    context->mapped = 0;
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < NODES; ++i) {
        struct node *node = &model->nodes[i];

        if (node->owner == (int)index) {
            node->owner = -1;
            node->published = 0;
            collect(model, node);
        }
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; ++i)
        if (context->slots[i].token)
            destroy_slot(model, &context->slots[i], 0);
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_REFS; ++i) {
        struct ref *ref = &context->refs[i];

        if (ref->node) {
            require(!ref->buffer, "final slots freed before refs");
            ref->user = 0;
            drop_ref(model, ref);
        }
    }
    return "OK";
}

static void initialize(struct model *model, int log_bootstrap)
{
    const unsigned int owners[] = { 1, 1, 2 };
    const unsigned int nodes[] = { 101, 102, 102 };
    const unsigned int cookies[] = { 11, 22, 22 };

    memset(model, 0, sizeof(*model));
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < CONTEXTS; ++i)
        model->contexts[i].alive = model->contexts[i].mapped = 1;
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < NODES; ++i)
        model->nodes[i] = (struct node){ .id = 101 + i, .cookie = 11 * (i + 1),
            .published = 1, .owner = 0, .allocated = 1,
            .value = i == 2 ? 1000 : (i == 1 ? 100 : 0) };
    model->allocations = NODES;
    model->xhandle = 2;
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        struct object object = { LOCAL, nodes[i], cookies[i] };
        unsigned int token, handle;
        struct slot *slot;

        require(!strcmp(parcel(model, 0, owners[i], &object, 1, GRANT, 0, &token), "OK"),
                "bootstrap export");
        slot = find_slot(model, owners[i], token);
        handle = slot->holds[0].ref->handle;
        require(!strcmp(import_grant(model, owners[i], token, 0), "OK"), "bootstrap import");
        require(!strcmp(user_ref(model, owners[i], handle, 1), "OK"), "bootstrap acquire");
        require(!strcmp(free_buffer(model, owners[i], token), "OK"), "bootstrap free");
        if (log_bootstrap)
            printf("event=bootstrap source=LOCAL context=%s node=%u handle=%u\n",
                   context_names[owners[i]], nodes[i], handle);
    }
    model->converted = 0;
}

static struct totals totals(const struct model *model)
{
    struct totals result = { 0 };

    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < NODES; ++i) {
        result.nodes += (unsigned int)model->nodes[i].allocated;
        result.locals += model->nodes[i].local;
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < CONTEXTS; ++i) {
        const struct context *context = &model->contexts[i];

        for (unsigned int j = 0; j < MAX_REFS; ++j)
            if (context->refs[j].node) {
                ++result.refs;
                result.users += context->refs[j].user;
                result.buffers += context->refs[j].buffer;
            }
        for (unsigned int j = 0; j < MAX_SLOTS; ++j)
            if (context->slots[j].token) {
                ++result.slots;
                result.pending += context->slots[j].kind == GRANT &&
                                  !context->slots[j].delivered;
            }
    }
    return result;
}

static void snapshot(const struct model *model, unsigned int step,
                     const char *operation, const char *status)
{
    struct totals count = totals(model);

    printf("event=step step=%u operation=%s status=%s nodes=%u refs=%u users=%llu "
           "buffers=%u locals=%u slots=%u pending=%u allocs=%u frees=%u "
           "state=%s node=%u value=", step, operation, status, count.nodes,
           count.refs, (unsigned long long)count.users, count.buffers, count.locals,
           count.slots, count.pending, model->allocations, model->frees,
           state_names[model->tx.state], model->observed_node);
    if (model->has_value)
        printf("%d", model->observed_value);
    else
        printf("none");
    printf(" converted=%u rolled_back=%u\n", model->converted, model->rolled_back);
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < NODES; ++i) {
        const struct node *node = &model->nodes[i];

        printf("event=node id=%u cookie=%u owner=%s allocated=%d published=%u "
               "transactions=%u target_slots=%u refs=%u local=%u\n", node->id,
               node->cookie, node->owner < 0 ? "none" : context_names[node->owner],
               node->allocated, node->published, node->transactions,
               node->target_slots, node->refs, node->local);
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < CONTEXTS; ++i) {
        const struct context *context = &model->contexts[i];

        for (unsigned int j = 0; j < MAX_REFS; ++j) {
            const struct ref *ref = &context->refs[j];

            if (ref->node)
                printf("event=ref context=%s handle=%u node=%u user=%u buffer=%u\n",
                       context_names[i], ref->handle, ref->node->id,
                       (unsigned int)ref->user, (unsigned int)ref->buffer);
        }
        for (unsigned int j = 0; j < MAX_SLOTS; ++j) {
            const struct slot *slot = &context->slots[j];

            if (!slot->token)
                continue;
            printf("event=slot context=%s token=%u kind=%s delivered=%u objects=%u target=%u\n",
                   context_names[i], slot->token, kind_names[slot->kind], slot->delivered,
                   slot->count, slot->target ? slot->target->id : 0);
            for (unsigned int k = 0; k < slot->count; ++k) {
                const struct hold *hold = &slot->holds[k];

                printf("event=hold context=%s token=%u index=%u type=%s node=%u handle=%u cookie=%u\n",
                       context_names[i], slot->token, k, hold->type == LOCAL ? "LOCAL" : "HANDLE",
                       hold->node->id, hold->ref ? hold->ref->handle : 0,
                       hold->type == LOCAL ? hold->node->cookie : 0);
            }
        }
    }
    if (model->tx.live)
        printf("event=tx node=%u state=%s\n", model->tx.target->id, state_names[model->tx.state]);
}

static const char *step(struct model *model, const char *operation)
{
    struct object objects[MAX_OBJECTS];
    unsigned int count = 1, token;
    const char *status;

    model->converted = model->rolled_back = model->observed_node = 0;
    model->has_value = 0;
    if (!strncmp(operation, "send_", 5)) {
        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MAX_OBJECTS; ++i)
            objects[i] = (struct object){ HANDLE, 1, 0 };
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_twice"))
            count = 2;
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_max"))
            count = MAX_OBJECTS;
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_bad") || !strcmp(operation, "send_unknown")) {
            count = 2;
            objects[1] = (struct object){ HANDLE, 99, 0 };
        }
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_bad_twice")) {
            count = 3;
            objects[2] = (struct object){ HANDLE, 99, 0 };
        }
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_unknown"))
            objects[1].type = 99;
        if (!strcmp(operation, "send_z")) {
            objects[0] = (struct object){ LOCAL, 103, 33 };
            return parcel(model, 0, 2, objects, 1, GRANT, 0, &model->zgrant);
        }
        status = parcel(model, 1, 2, objects, count, GRANT,
                        !strcmp(operation, "send_fault"), &token);
        if (!strcmp(status, "OK")) {
            struct slot *slot = find_slot(model, 2, token);

            model->xgrant = token;
            model->xhandle = slot->holds[0].ref->handle;
        }
        return status;
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "forge_local") || !strcmp(operation, "wrong_cookie")) {
        struct object object = { LOCAL, 101, !strcmp(operation, "wrong_cookie") ? 99 : 11 };

        return parcel(model, !strcmp(operation, "wrong_cookie") ? 0 : 1,
                      2, &object, 1, GRANT, 0, &token);
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "forged_handle"))
        return dispatch(model, 2, 99, 1);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "wrong_import"))
        return import_grant(model, 1, model->xgrant, 0);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "import_x") || !strcmp(operation, "import_fault"))
        return import_grant(model, 2, model->xgrant, !strcmp(operation, "import_fault"));
    if (!strcmp(operation, "acquire_x") || !strcmp(operation, "release_x"))
        return user_ref(model, 2, model->xhandle, !strcmp(operation, "acquire_x"));
    if (!strcmp(operation, "free_x"))
        return free_buffer(model, 2, model->xgrant);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "use_x") || !strcmp(operation, "stale_x"))
        return dispatch(model, 2, model->xhandle, 1);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "return_owner")) {
        struct object object = { HANDLE, 1, 0 };

        return parcel(model, 1, 0, &object, 1, GRANT, 0, &model->owner_grant);
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "import_owner"))
        return import_grant(model, 0, model->owner_grant, 0);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "free_owner"))
        return free_buffer(model, 0, model->owner_grant);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "import_z"))
        return import_grant(model, 2, model->zgrant, 0);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "free_z"))
        return free_buffer(model, 2, model->zgrant);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "call"))
        return begin_call(model);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "deliver") || !strcmp(operation, "receive_fault")) {
        struct slot *slot;

        if (!model->tx.live || model->tx.state != QUEUED)
            return "ENOENT";
        if (!strcmp(operation, "receive_fault"))
            return "EFAULT";
        slot = find_slot(model, 0, model->tx.request);
        require(slot != NULL, "queued transaction owns request");
        slot->delivered = 1;
        model->tx.state = DELIVERED;
        return "OK";
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "cancel")) {
        if (!model->tx.live || terminal(&model->tx))
            return "ENOENT";
        finish(model, FAILED);
        return "OK";
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "reap")) {
        if (!model->tx.live || !terminal(&model->tx))
            return "ENOENT";
        reap(model);
        return "OK";
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "free_request"))
        return free_buffer(model, 0, model->tx.request);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "reply") || !strcmp(operation, "reply_object") ||
        !strcmp(operation, "reply_fault"))
        return reply(model, strcmp(operation, "reply") != 0,
                     !strcmp(operation, "reply_fault"));
    if (!strcmp(operation, "return_reply") || !strcmp(operation, "call_output_fault")) {
        struct slot *slot = find_slot(model, 2, model->tx.reply);

        if (model->tx.state != REPLIED || !slot || slot->delivered)
            return "ENOENT";
        if (!strcmp(operation, "call_output_fault")) {
            destroy_slot(model, slot, 1);
            return "EFAULT";
        }
        slot->delivered = 1;
        return "OK";
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "free_reply"))
        return free_buffer(model, 2, model->tx.reply);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "close_a"))
        return close_context(model, 0);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "close_b"))
        return close_context(model, 1);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "close_c"))
        return close_context(model, 2);
    if (!strcmp(operation, "unmap_c")) {
        if (!model->contexts[2].alive || !model->contexts[2].mapped)
            return "ENOENT";
        model->contexts[2].mapped = 0;
        return "OK";
    }
    if (!strcmp(operation, "remap_c"))
        return model->contexts[2].alive ? "EBUSY" : "EBADF";
    require(0, "validated operation has implementation");
    return "EINVAL";
}

static void result(struct model *model, unsigned int context,
                   unsigned int handle, unsigned int amount)
{
    const char *status;

    model->has_value = 0;
    model->observed_node = 0;
    status = dispatch(model, context, handle, amount);
    printf("event=result context=%s handle=%u status=%s node=%u value=",
           context_names[context], handle, status, model->observed_node);
    if (model->has_value)
        printf("%d\n", model->observed_value);
    else
        printf("none\n");
}

static int usage(void)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: references raw|transfer|trace EVENT...\n");
    return 2;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    struct model model;

    if (argc < 2)
        return usage();
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "trace")) {
        if (argc < 3)
            return usage();
        for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
            unsigned int j;

            for (j = 0; j < sizeof(operations) / sizeof(operations[0]); ++j)
                if (!strcmp(argv[i], operations[j]))
                    break;
            if (j == sizeof(operations) / sizeof(operations[0]))
                return usage();
        }
        initialize(&model, 0);
        snapshot(&model, 0, "init", "OK");
        for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i) {
            const char *status = step(&model, argv[i]);

            snapshot(&model, (unsigned int)(i - 1), argv[i], status);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc != 2 || (strcmp(argv[1], "raw") && strcmp(argv[1], "transfer")))
        return usage();
    initialize(&model, 1);
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "raw")) {
        result(&model, 2, 1, 1);
        result(&model, 2, 2, 1);
    } else {
        const char *const transfer[] = { "send_x", "import_x", "acquire_x", "free_x" };

        for (unsigned int i = 0; i < sizeof(transfer) / sizeof(transfer[0]); ++i) {
            const char *status = step(&model, transfer[i]);

            require(!strcmp(status, "OK"), "transfer demonstration");
            snapshot(&model, i + 1, transfer[i], status);
        }
        result(&model, 2, 2, 1);
        result(&model, 1, 1, 2);
        result(&model, 2, 1, 1);
    }
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < CONTEXTS; ++i)
        require(!strcmp(close_context(&model, i), "OK"), "demonstration final close");
    {
        struct totals count = totals(&model);

        printf("event=summary nodes=%u refs=%u slots=%u pending=%u\n",
               count.nodes, count.refs, count.slots, count.pending);
    }
    return 0;
}

#include <stdint.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

enum state { NEW, QUEUED, DELIVERED, COMPLETED, LOST };

struct request {
    unsigned int id;
    unsigned int client;
    uint32_t a, b;
    enum state state;
};

struct queue {
    struct request *items[2];
    size_t count;
};

static void deliver(struct request *request)
{
    request->state = DELIVERED;
    printf("event=delivered request_id=%u\n", request->id);
}

static int reply(struct request *requests, size_t count,
                 unsigned int id, uint32_t result)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        struct request *request = &requests[i];

        if (request->id != id)
            continue;
        if (request->state != DELIVERED) {
            printf("event=reply_rejected request_id=%u reason=%s\n", id,
                   request->state == COMPLETED ? "duplicate" : "not_delivered");
            return -1;
        }
        request->state = COMPLETED;
        printf("event=client_result client=%u request_id=%u result=%" PRIu32 "\n",
               request->client, id, result);
        return 0;
    }
    printf("event=reply_rejected request_id=%u reason=unknown\n", id);
    return -1;
}

static int enqueue(struct queue *queue, struct request *request)
{
    if (queue->count == sizeof(queue->items) / sizeof(queue->items[0])) {
        printf("event=refused request_id=%u reason=queue_full\n", request->id);
        return -1;
    }
    request->state = QUEUED;
    queue->items[queue->count++] = request;
    printf("event=queued request_id=%u\n", request->id);
    return 0;
}

static struct request *receive(struct queue *queue)
{
    struct request *request;

    if (queue->count == 0)
        return NULL;
    request = queue->items[0];
    for (size_t i = 1; i < queue->count; ++i)
        queue->items[i - 1] = queue->items[i];
    --queue->count;
    deliver(request);
    return request;
}

static void run_slot(struct request requests[3], int overwrite)
{
    struct request *slot = &requests[0];

    slot->state = QUEUED;
    printf("event=queued request_id=%u\n", slot->id);
    if (overwrite) {
        printf("event=overwritten request_id=%u client=%u\n", slot->id, slot->client);
        slot->state = LOST;
        slot = &requests[1];
        slot->state = QUEUED;
        printf("event=queued request_id=%u\n", slot->id);
    } else {
        printf("event=refused request_id=%u reason=slot_full\n", requests[1].id);
    }
    deliver(slot);
    reply(requests, 3, slot->id, slot->a + slot->b);
    slot = NULL;
    if (!overwrite) {
        printf("event=retry request_id=%u\n", requests[1].id);
        slot = &requests[1];
        slot->state = QUEUED;
        printf("event=queued request_id=%u\n", slot->id);
        deliver(slot);
        reply(requests, 3, slot->id, slot->a + slot->b);
    }
}

static int run_fifo(struct request requests[3])
{
    struct queue queue = { { NULL, NULL }, 0 };
    struct request *first, *second;

    if (enqueue(&queue, &requests[0]) || enqueue(&queue, &requests[1]))
        return 1;
    if (enqueue(&queue, &requests[2]) == 0)
        return 1;
    if (reply(requests, 3, 999, 0) == 0 ||
        reply(requests, 3, requests[0].id, 0) == 0)
        return 1;
    first = receive(&queue);
    second = receive(&queue);
    if (!first || !second || receive(&queue) != NULL)
        return 1;
    /* Delivery order need not be reply order; each ID selects its own client. */
    if (reply(requests, 3, second->id, second->a + second->b) ||
        reply(requests, 3, second->id, 999) == 0 ||
        reply(requests, 3, first->id, first->a + first->b))
        return 1;
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    struct request requests[3] = {
        { 101, 1, 1, 2, NEW },
        { 102, 2, 19, 23, NEW },
        { 103, 3, 5, 8, NEW },
    };

    if (argc != 2 || (strcmp(argv[1], "overwrite") != 0 &&
                      strcmp(argv[1], "refuse") != 0 &&
                      strcmp(argv[1], "fifo") != 0)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: request_queue overwrite|refuse|fifo\n");
        return 2;
    }
    if (strcmp(argv[1], "fifo") == 0)
        return run_fifo(requests);
    run_slot(requests, strcmp(argv[1], "overwrite") == 0);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

enum state { QUEUED, DELIVERED, REPLIED, FAILED };
enum request_owner { REQUEST_DRIVER, REQUEST_SERVER, REQUEST_NONE };
enum reply_owner { REPLY_NONE, REPLY_PREPARED, REPLY_CLIENT };
enum output_state { OUTPUT_NONE, OUTPUT_PENDING, OUTPUT_DELIVERED, OUTPUT_FAULT };
enum display { QUIET, WITH_RESULTS, TABLE_ONLY };
enum event {
    EV_DELIVER, EV_RECEIVE_FAULT, EV_REPLY, EV_REPLY_EMPTY, EV_REPLY_FAULT,
    EV_CANCEL, EV_SERVER_EXIT, EV_WRONG_REPLY, EV_OUTPUT_OK, EV_OUTPUT_FAULT,
    EV_FREE_REQUEST, EV_FREE_REPLY, EV_REAP, EVENT_COUNT
};

static const char *const state_names[] = {"QUEUED", "DELIVERED", "REPLIED", "FAILED"};
static const char *const request_names[] = {"DRIVER", "SERVER", "NONE"};
static const char *const reply_names[] = {"NONE", "PREPARED", "CLIENT"};
static const char *const output_names[] = {"NONE", "PENDING", "DELIVERED", "FAULT"};
static const char *const event_names[] = {
    "deliver", "receive_fault", "reply", "reply_empty", "reply_fault",
    "cancel", "server_exit", "wrong_reply", "output_ok", "output_fault",
    "free_request", "free_reply", "reap"
};

struct transaction {
    unsigned int id, logical_call, client, sequence, result;
    enum state state;
    enum request_owner request;
    enum reply_owner reply;
    enum output_state output;
    unsigned int terminal_count, request_frees, reply_allocs, reply_frees;
    unsigned int record_live, record_reaps;
    int server_alive;
};

static struct transaction make_transaction(unsigned int id, unsigned int call,
                                           unsigned int result)
{
    struct transaction transaction = {0};
    transaction.id = id;
    transaction.logical_call = call;
    transaction.client = 1;
    transaction.sequence = 7;
    transaction.result = result;
    transaction.state = QUEUED;
    transaction.request = REQUEST_DRIVER;
    transaction.record_live = 1;
    transaction.server_alive = 1;
    return transaction;
}

static int terminal(enum state state)
{
    return state == REPLIED || state == FAILED;
}

static int valid(const struct transaction *transaction)
{
    return transaction->terminal_count == (unsigned int)terminal(transaction->state) &&
        transaction->request_frees == (unsigned int)(transaction->request == REQUEST_NONE) &&
        transaction->reply_allocs >= transaction->reply_frees &&
        transaction->reply_allocs - transaction->reply_frees ==
            (unsigned int)(transaction->reply != REPLY_NONE) &&
        transaction->record_reaps == 1 - transaction->record_live &&
        (transaction->record_live || terminal(transaction->state)) &&
        (transaction->request != REQUEST_DRIVER || transaction->state == QUEUED) &&
        (transaction->request != REQUEST_SERVER || transaction->state != QUEUED) &&
        (transaction->server_alive || transaction->request == REQUEST_NONE) &&
        ((transaction->output != OUTPUT_NONE) == (transaction->state == REPLIED)) &&
        (transaction->reply != REPLY_PREPARED || transaction->output == OUTPUT_PENDING) &&
        (transaction->reply != REPLY_CLIENT || transaction->output == OUTPUT_DELIVERED);
}

static void finish_transaction(struct transaction *transaction, enum state state)
{
    transaction->state = state;
    ++transaction->terminal_count;
}

static void release_request(struct transaction *transaction)
{
    if (transaction->request != REQUEST_NONE) {
        transaction->request = REQUEST_NONE;
        ++transaction->request_frees;
    }
}

static int needs_record(enum event event)
{
    return event == EV_DELIVER || event == EV_RECEIVE_FAULT || event == EV_REPLY ||
        event == EV_REPLY_EMPTY || event == EV_REPLY_FAULT || event == EV_CANCEL ||
        event == EV_WRONG_REPLY;
}

static int step(struct transaction *transaction, enum event event, enum display display)
{
    enum state before = transaction->state;
    const char *reason = "ok";
    int accepted = 0;

    if (needs_record(event) && !transaction->record_live) {
        reason = "unknown";
        goto observed;
    }
    switch (event) {
    case EV_DELIVER:
    case EV_RECEIVE_FAULT:
        if (transaction->state != QUEUED) {
            reason = terminal(transaction->state) ? "terminal" : "not_queued";
            break;
        }
        if (event == EV_DELIVER) {
            transaction->state = DELIVERED;
            transaction->request = REQUEST_SERVER;
        } else {
            reason = "receive_rollback";
        }
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_REPLY:
    case EV_REPLY_EMPTY:
    case EV_REPLY_FAULT:
        if (transaction->state != DELIVERED) {
            reason = terminal(transaction->state) ? "terminal" : "not_delivered";
            break;
        }
        if (event == EV_REPLY_FAULT) {
            ++transaction->reply_allocs;
            ++transaction->reply_frees;
            reason = "reply_rollback";
        } else {
            if (event == EV_REPLY) {
                transaction->reply = REPLY_PREPARED;
                ++transaction->reply_allocs;
            }
            transaction->output = OUTPUT_PENDING;
            finish_transaction(transaction, REPLIED);
        }
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_CANCEL:
        if (terminal(transaction->state)) {
            reason = "terminal";
            break;
        }
        if (transaction->state == QUEUED)
            release_request(transaction);
        finish_transaction(transaction, FAILED);
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_SERVER_EXIT:
        if (!transaction->server_alive) {
            reason = "server_gone";
            break;
        }
        transaction->server_alive = 0;
        release_request(transaction);
        if (!terminal(transaction->state))
            finish_transaction(transaction, FAILED);
        accepted = 1;
        reason = "server_cleanup";
        break;
    case EV_WRONG_REPLY:
        reason = "wrong_server";
        break;
    case EV_OUTPUT_OK:
    case EV_OUTPUT_FAULT:
        if (transaction->output != OUTPUT_PENDING) {
            reason = "no_pending_output";
            break;
        }
        if (event == EV_OUTPUT_OK) {
            transaction->output = OUTPUT_DELIVERED;
            if (transaction->reply == REPLY_PREPARED)
                transaction->reply = REPLY_CLIENT;
        } else {
            transaction->output = OUTPUT_FAULT;
            if (transaction->reply == REPLY_PREPARED) {
                transaction->reply = REPLY_NONE;
                ++transaction->reply_frees;
            }
            reason = "output_rollback";
        }
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_FREE_REQUEST:
        if (transaction->request != REQUEST_SERVER) {
            reason = transaction->request == REQUEST_DRIVER ? "not_delivered" : "not_owned";
            break;
        }
        release_request(transaction);
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_FREE_REPLY:
        if (transaction->reply != REPLY_CLIENT) {
            reason = transaction->reply == REPLY_PREPARED ? "not_delivered" : "not_owned";
            break;
        }
        transaction->reply = REPLY_NONE;
        ++transaction->reply_frees;
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EV_REAP:
        if (!terminal(transaction->state) || !transaction->record_live) {
            reason = transaction->record_live ? "not_terminal" : "already_reaped";
            break;
        }
        transaction->record_live = 0;
        ++transaction->record_reaps;
        accepted = 1;
        break;
    case EVENT_COUNT:
        reason = "invalid_event";
        break;
    }

observed:
    if (!valid(transaction)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "transaction invariant failed id=%u event=%s\n",
                transaction->id, event_names[event]);
        exit(1);
    }
    if (display != QUIET) {
        printf("event=step id=%u logical_call=%u client=%u sequence=%u operation=%s "
               "accepted=%d reason=%s from=%s state=%s terminal_count=%u "
               "request=%s reply=%s output=%s record_live=%u request_frees=%u "
               "reply_allocs=%u reply_frees=%u record_reaps=%u server_alive=%d\n",
               transaction->id, transaction->logical_call, transaction->client,
               transaction->sequence, event_names[event], accepted, reason,
               state_names[before], state_names[transaction->state], transaction->terminal_count,
               request_names[transaction->request], reply_names[transaction->reply],
               output_names[transaction->output], transaction->record_live,
               transaction->request_frees, transaction->reply_allocs, transaction->reply_frees,
               transaction->record_reaps, transaction->server_alive);
        if (display == WITH_RESULTS && accepted && event == EV_OUTPUT_OK) {
            printf("event=client_result id=%u logical_call=%u client=%u sequence=%u result=",
                   transaction->id, transaction->logical_call, transaction->client,
                   transaction->sequence);
            if (transaction->reply == REPLY_CLIENT)
                printf("%u\n", transaction->result);
            else
                puts("none");
        }
    }
    return accepted;
}

static void expect_step(struct transaction *transaction, enum event event, int accepted)
{
    if (step(transaction, event, WITH_RESULTS) != accepted) {
        fprintf(stderr, "unexpected event outcome id=%u event=%s\n",
                transaction->id, event_names[event]);
        exit(1);
    }
}

static int reply_id(struct transaction *transactions, size_t count, unsigned int id)
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
        if (transactions[i].id == id && transactions[i].record_live)
            return step(&transactions[i], EV_REPLY, WITH_RESULTS);
    printf("event=rejected id=%u reason=unknown\n", id);
    return 0;
}

static void summary(const struct transaction *transactions, size_t count)
{
    unsigned int records = 0, requests = 0, replies = 0, terminals = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        records += transactions[i].record_live;
        requests += transactions[i].request != REQUEST_NONE;
        replies += transactions[i].reply != REPLY_NONE;
        terminals += transactions[i].terminal_count;
    }
    printf("event=summary records=%u request_slots=%u reply_slots=%u terminal_total=%u\n",
           records, requests, replies, terminals);
}

static void run_slot(void)
{
    unsigned int slot = 42;
    printf("event=slot_write logical_call=2 client=1 sequence=7 result=%u overwritten_call=none\n", slot);
    slot = 3;
    printf("event=slot_write logical_call=1 client=1 sequence=7 result=%u overwritten_call=2\n", slot);
    printf("event=slot_read logical_call=1 client=1 sequence=7 expected=3 observed=%u\n", slot);
    printf("event=slot_read logical_call=2 client=1 sequence=7 expected=42 observed=%u\n", slot);
}

static void run_reorder(void)
{
    struct transaction transactions[2] = {
        make_transaction(101, 1, 3), make_transaction(102, 2, 42)
    };
    if (reply_id(transactions, 2, 101) || reply_id(transactions, 2, 999))
        exit(1);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_DELIVER, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_DELIVER, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_WRONG_REPLY, 0);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_FREE_REQUEST, 1);
    if (!reply_id(transactions, 2, 102) || reply_id(transactions, 2, 102))
        exit(1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_REAP, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_OUTPUT_OK, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_FREE_REQUEST, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[1], EV_FREE_REPLY, 1);
    if (!reply_id(transactions, 2, 101))
        exit(1);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_CANCEL, 0);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_REAP, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_OUTPUT_OK, 1);
    expect_step(&transactions[0], EV_FREE_REPLY, 1);
    summary(transactions, 2);
}

static void run_matrix(void)
{
    for (enum state state = QUEUED; state <= FAILED; ++state) {
        for (enum event event = EV_DELIVER; event < EVENT_COUNT; ++event) {
            struct transaction transaction = make_transaction(101, 1, 3);
            if (state != QUEUED)
                step(&transaction, EV_DELIVER, QUIET);
            if (state == REPLIED)
                step(&transaction, EV_REPLY, QUIET);
            else if (state == FAILED)
                step(&transaction, EV_CANCEL, QUIET);
            step(&transaction, event, TABLE_ONLY);
        }
    }
}

static enum event parse_event(const char *name)
{
    for (enum event event = EV_DELIVER; event < EVENT_COUNT; ++event)
        if (!strcmp(name, event_names[event]))
            return event;
    return EVENT_COUNT;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "slot")) {
        run_slot();
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "reorder")) {
        run_reorder();
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc == 2 && !strcmp(argv[1], "matrix")) {
        run_matrix();
        return 0;
    }
    if (argc >= 3 && !strcmp(argv[1], "trace")) {
        struct transaction transaction = make_transaction(101, 1, 3);
        for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i)
            if (parse_event(argv[i]) == EVENT_COUNT)
                goto usage;
        for (int i = 2; i < argc; ++i)
            step(&transaction, parse_event(argv[i]), WITH_RESULTS);
        summary(&transaction, 1);
        return 0;
    }
usage:
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: transactions slot|reorder|matrix|trace EVENT...\n");
    return 2;
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/slab.h>

static bool fail_init;
module_param(fail_init, bool, 0444);
MODULE_PARM_DESC(fail_init, "Return an error after allocating and freeing state");
static void *state;

static int __init mini_hello_init(void)
{
    state = kzalloc(64, GFP_KERNEL);
    if (!state)
        return -ENOMEM;
    if (fail_init) {
        kfree(state);
        state = NULL;
        pr_info("mini_hello: init rollback\n");
        return -EINVAL;
    }
    pr_info("mini_hello: init ok\n");
    return 0;
}

static void __exit mini_hello_exit(void)
{
    kfree(state);
    pr_info("mini_hello: exit ok\n");
}

module_init(mini_hello_init);
module_exit(mini_hello_exit);
MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Teaching module with a controlled initialization rollback");

#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

int main(void)
{
    int descriptors[2], saved_errno;
    ssize_t count;
    char value = '\0';

    if (pipe(descriptors) < 0) {
        perror("pipe");
        return 1;
    }
    errno = EDOM;
    count = write(descriptors[1], "X", 1);
    saved_errno = errno;
    printf("event=write_success return=%ld errno=%d decision=%s\n",
           (long)count, saved_errno, count == 1 ? "success" : "failure");
    if (count != 1) {
        close(descriptors[0]);
        close(descriptors[1]);
        return 1;
    }
    count = read(descriptors[0], &value, 1);
    printf("event=payload_read return=%ld value=%c\n", (long)count, value);
    close(descriptors[0]);
    close(descriptors[1]);
    if (count != 1 || value != 'X')
        return 1;

    count = write(-1, "X", 1);
    saved_errno = errno;
    printf("event=write_failure return=%ld errno=%d decision=stop\n",
           (long)count, saved_errno);
    return count == -1 && saved_errno == EBADF ? 0 : 1;
}
