#define CHECK(condition) do { \
    if (!(condition)) { \
        fprintf(stderr, "transaction_test pid=%ld line=%d errno=%d\n", \
                (long)getpid(), __LINE__, errno); \
        exit(1); \
    } \
} while (0)

struct fixture {
    int service, client;
    const unsigned char *request_base, *reply_base;
};

struct job {
    pthread_t thread;
    int fd, done[2], release[2], result, error;
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES];
    struct mb_transaction_call call;
    struct mb_transaction_call *control;
    int readonly_output;
};

struct child_server {
    pid_t pid;
    int command, report;
};

static int observer = -1;
static pid_t owner;
static volatile sig_atomic_t active_child = -1;
static uint64_t last_received_id;

static void cleanup(void)
{
    int status;
    pid_t child = active_child;

    if (getpid() != owner || child <= 0)
        return;
    kill(child, SIGKILL);
    while (waitpid(child, &status, 0) < 0 && errno == EINTR)
        ;
    active_child = -1;
}

static void deadline(int number)
{
    (void)number;
    if (getpid() == owner && active_child > 0)
        kill(active_child, SIGKILL);
    _exit(124);
}

static void interrupted(int number)
{
    (void)number;
}

static int open_device(void)
{
    int fd = open("/dev/mini_binder", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
    CHECK(fd >= 0);
    return fd;
}

static const unsigned char *map_region(int fd)
{
    void *base = mmap(NULL, MB_MAP_BYTES, PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0);
    CHECK(base != MAP_FAILED);
    return base;
}

static void transfer(int fd, void *buffer, size_t size, int writing)
{
    unsigned char *cursor = buffer;

    while (size) {
        struct pollfd item = { .fd = fd, .events = writing ? POLLOUT : POLLIN };
        int ready = poll(&item, 1, 5000);
        ssize_t count;

        if (ready < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            continue;
        CHECK(ready == 1);
        count = writing ? write(fd, cursor, size) : read(fd, cursor, size);
        if (count < 0 && errno == EINTR)
            continue;
        CHECK(count > 0);
        cursor += count;
        size -= (size_t)count;
    }
}

static void token_io(int fd, int writing)
{
    char token = 'T';
    transfer(fd, &token, sizeof(token), writing);
    CHECK(token == 'T');
}

static struct mb_buffer_stats buffer_stats(int fd)
{
    struct mb_buffer_stats stats = { 0 };
    CHECK(ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_BUFFER_STATS, &stats) == 0);
    return stats;
}

static void await_counts(unsigned int queued, unsigned int delivered)
{
    struct timespec start, now;
    CHECK(clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start) == 0);
    for (;;) {
        struct mb_stats stats;
        CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_STATS, &stats) == 0);
        if (stats.queued == queued && stats.delivered == delivered &&
            stats.live_requests == queued + delivered)
            return;
        CHECK(clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now) == 0);
        CHECK(now.tv_sec - start.tv_sec < 5);
        sched_yield();
    }
}

static void clean_baseline(void)
{
    struct mb_query query;
    struct mb_stats stats;
    struct mb_buffer_stats buffers;

    await_counts(0, 0);
    CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_STATS, &stats) == 0 && !stats.server_registered);
    CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_QUERY, &query) == 0 && query.live_contexts == 1);
    buffers = buffer_stats(observer);
    CHECK(buffers.live_regions == 0 && buffers.live_slots == 0);
}

static void open_fixture(struct fixture *fixture, int legacy)
{
    fixture->service = open_device();
    fixture->client = open_device();
    fixture->request_base = map_region(fixture->service);
    fixture->reply_base = map_region(fixture->client);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture->service, legacy ? MB_IOC_REGISTER_BUFFER :
                MB_IOC_REGISTER_TRANSACTION) == 0);
}

static void close_fixture(struct fixture *fixture)
{
    await_counts(0, 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture->service).used_slots == 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture->client).used_slots == 0);
    if (fixture->request_base != MAP_FAILED)
        CHECK(munmap((void *)fixture->request_base, MB_MAP_BYTES) == 0);
    if (fixture->reply_base != MAP_FAILED)
        CHECK(munmap((void *)fixture->reply_base, MB_MAP_BYTES) == 0);
    CHECK(close(fixture->service) == 0);
    CHECK(close(fixture->client) == 0);
    clean_baseline();
}

static size_t encode(unsigned char *wire, int32_t marker)
{
    const unsigned char label[] = { 'A', 0, 'B' };
    const int32_t values[] = { marker, -marker };
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    size_t size;

    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, MBP_MAX_BYTES, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_u32(&writer, 77, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_i32(&writer, marker, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, label, sizeof(label), 0, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, values, 2, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, NULL));
    return size;
}

static int32_t decode(const unsigned char *wire, size_t size)
{
    const unsigned char *label;
    const unsigned char expected[] = { 'A', 0, 'B' };
    int32_t marker, values[2];
    uint32_t sequence;
    size_t label_size, count;
    int is_null;
    struct mbp_reader reader;

    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_read_u32(&reader, &sequence, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_read_i32(&reader, &marker, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &label, &label_size, &is_null, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, values, 2, &count, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, NULL));
    CHECK(sequence == 77 && !is_null && label_size == sizeof(expected));
    CHECK(memcmp(label, expected, sizeof(expected)) == 0);
    CHECK(count == 2 && values[0] == marker && values[1] == -marker);
    return marker;
}

static void *call_thread(void *argument)
{
    struct job *job = argument;

    errno = 0;
    job->result = ioctl(job->fd, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, job->control);
    job->error = errno;
    if (!job->result)
        job->call = *job->control;
    token_io(job->done[1], 1);
    /* Keep a completed thread alive until its owner releases and joins it. */
    token_io(job->release[0], 0);
    return NULL;
}

static void start_job(struct job *job, int fd, int32_t marker, int readonly_output)
{
    memset(job, 0, sizeof(*job));
    job->fd = fd;
    job->call.data = (uintptr_t)job->wire;
    job->call.size = (uint32_t)encode(job->wire, marker);
    job->control = &job->call;
    job->readonly_output = readonly_output;
    if (readonly_output) {
        job->control = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                            MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
        CHECK(job->control != MAP_FAILED);
        *job->control = job->call;
        CHECK(mprotect(job->control, 4096, PROT_READ) == 0);
    }
    CHECK(pipe(job->done) == 0 && pipe(job->release) == 0);
    CHECK(pthread_create(&job->thread, NULL, call_thread, job) == 0);
}

static void finish_job(struct job *job, int expected_error)
{
    struct timespec limit;

    token_io(job->done[0], 0);
    token_io(job->release[1], 1);
    CHECK(clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &limit) == 0);
    limit.tv_sec += 5;
    CHECK(pthread_timedjoin_np(job->thread, NULL, &limit) == 0);
    CHECK(expected_error ? job->result == -1 && job->error == expected_error :
                          job->result == 0);
    if (job->readonly_output) {
        CHECK(memcmp(job->control, &job->call, sizeof(job->call)) == 0);
        CHECK(munmap(job->control, 4096) == 0);
    }
    CHECK(close(job->done[0]) == 0 && close(job->done[1]) == 0);
    CHECK(close(job->release[0]) == 0 && close(job->release[1]) == 0);
}

static struct mb_buffer_request receive_request(struct fixture *fixture, int32_t marker)
{
    struct mb_buffer_request request;

    CHECK(ioctl(fixture->service, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, &request) == 0);
    CHECK(request.id && request.token && !request.reserved);
    CHECK(request.size <= MB_MAX_PAYLOAD &&
          request.offset <= MB_MAP_BYTES - request.size);
    CHECK(request.offset % MB_MAX_PAYLOAD == 0);
    CHECK(decode(fixture->request_base + request.offset, request.size) == marker);
    CHECK(request.id > last_received_id);
    last_received_id = request.id;
    return request;
}

static void free_token(int fd, uint64_t token)
{
    CHECK(token != 0 && ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &token) == 0);
}

static void reply_empty(int fd, uint64_t id, int status)
{
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply = { .id = id, .status = status };
    CHECK(ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == 0);
}

static void reply_data(int fd, uint64_t id, int32_t marker, int status)
{
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES];
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply = { .id = id, .data = (uintptr_t)wire,
                                         .status = status };
    reply.size = (uint32_t)encode(wire, marker);
    CHECK(ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == 0);
}

static void check_reply(struct fixture *fixture, struct job *job, int32_t marker,
                         int status)
{
    CHECK(job->call.data == (uintptr_t)job->wire && !job->call.reserved);
    CHECK(job->call.token && job->call.reply_size && job->call.reply_size <= MB_MAX_PAYLOAD);
    CHECK(job->call.offset <= MB_MAP_BYTES - job->call.reply_size);
    CHECK(job->call.offset % MB_MAX_PAYLOAD == 0 && job->call.status == status);
    CHECK(decode(fixture->reply_base + job->call.offset, job->call.reply_size) == marker);
}

static void check_empty(struct job *job, int status)
{
    CHECK(job->call.token == 0 && job->call.offset == 0 && job->call.reply_size == 0);
    CHECK(job->call.status == status);
}

static void mode_and_input_errors(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct mb_buffer_request request;
    struct mb_reply old_reply = { 0 };
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply = { 0 };
    unsigned char data = 1;
    struct mb_transaction_call call = { .data = (uintptr_t)&data, .size = 1 };
    struct mb_call old_call = { 0 };

    CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_REGISTER_TRANSACTION) == -1 && errno == ENXIO);
    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY, &old_reply) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_BUFFER, &request) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL, &old_call) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EPERM);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, &request) == -1 && errno == EPERM);
    CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == ENXIO);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, (void *)1) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    call.size = 0;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == EINVAL);
    call.size = MB_MAX_PAYLOAD + 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == EINVAL);
    call.size = 1;
    call.reserved = 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == EINVAL);
    call.reserved = 0;
    call.data = 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    close_fixture(&fixture);

    open_fixture(&fixture, 1);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, &request) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    call.data = (uintptr_t)&data;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call) == -1 && errno == EPROTOTYPE);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE modes=isolated input_errors=validated");
}

static void reverse_replies(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct job first, second;
    struct mb_buffer_request requests[2];
    struct mb_transaction_reply wrong = { .id = UINT64_MAX };

    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    start_job(&first, fixture.client, 11, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    start_job(&second, fixture.client, 22, 0);
    await_counts(2, 0);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &wrong) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, (void *)1) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    await_counts(2, 0);
    {
        void *readonly = mmap(NULL, 4096, PROT_READ,
                               MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
        CHECK(readonly != MAP_FAILED);
        CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, readonly) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
        await_counts(2, 0);
        CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 2);
        CHECK(munmap(readonly, 4096) == 0);
    }
    requests[0] = receive_request(&fixture, 11);
    requests[1] = receive_request(&fixture, 22);
    CHECK(requests[0].id != requests[1].id && requests[0].token != requests[1].token);
    await_counts(0, 2);
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
        CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &requests[i].token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    free_token(fixture.service, requests[1].token);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &requests[1].token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    reply_data(fixture.service, requests[1].id, 220, -22);
    finish_job(&second, 0);
    check_reply(&fixture, &second, 220, -22);
    await_counts(0, 1);
    wrong.id = requests[1].id;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &wrong) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == 1);
    reply_data(fixture.service, requests[0].id, 110, 0);
    finish_job(&first, 0);
    check_reply(&fixture, &first, 110, 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == 2);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &first.call.token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &second.call.token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    free_token(fixture.service, requests[0].token);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &requests[0].token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    free_token(fixture.client, first.call.token);
    free_token(fixture.client, second.call.token);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &first.call.token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_FREE_BUFFER, &second.call.token) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE same_fd_threads=2 sequence=77 reverse_replies=associated buffers=independent");
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE receive_EFAULT=retryable token_owner=validated duplicate_free=ENOENT");
}

static void reply_failures(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct job job;
    struct mb_buffer_request request;
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply;
    unsigned char *pages;
    uint64_t predicted;

    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    predicted = last_received_id + 1;
    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 31, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    /* Isolated white-box probe; RECEIVE below confirms the predicted queued ID. */
    reply = (struct mb_transaction_reply){ .id = predicted };
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 31);
    CHECK(request.id == predicted);
    await_counts(0, 1);
    reply.id = request.id;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.client, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EPERM);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, (void *)1) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    reply.size = MB_MAX_PAYLOAD + 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EINVAL);
    reply.size = 0;
    reply.data = 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EINVAL);
    reply.size = 1;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    pages = mmap(NULL, 8192, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                  MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
    CHECK(pages != MAP_FAILED);
    memset(pages, 0x5a, 4096);
    CHECK(mprotect(pages + 4096, 4096, PROT_NONE) == 0);
    reply.data = (uintptr_t)(pages + 4094);
    reply.size = 4;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EFAULT);
    CHECK(munmap(pages, 8192) == 0);
    await_counts(0, 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == 0);
    reply_data(fixture.service, request.id, 310, 0);
    finish_job(&job, 0);
    check_reply(&fixture, &job, 310, 0);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
    free_token(fixture.client, job.call.token);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE reply_errors=retryable partial_copy=EFAULT queued_reply=ENOENT");
}

static void reply_capacity(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct job job;
    uint64_t tokens[MB_MAP_SLOTS];
    struct mb_buffer_request request;
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES];
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply = { .data = (uintptr_t)wire };

    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MB_MAP_SLOTS; ++i) {
        start_job(&job, fixture.client, (int32_t)i + 1, 0);
        await_counts(1, 0);
        request = receive_request(&fixture, (int32_t)i + 1);
        free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
        reply_data(fixture.service, request.id, (int32_t)i + 100, 0);
        finish_job(&job, 0);
        check_reply(&fixture, &job, (int32_t)i + 100, 0);
        tokens[i] = job.call.token;
        CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == i + 1);
        await_counts(0, 0);
    }
    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 51, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 51);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
    reply.id = request.id;
    reply.size = (uint32_t)encode(wire, 510);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == -1 && errno == EAGAIN);
    await_counts(0, 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == MB_MAP_SLOTS);
    free_token(fixture.client, tokens[0]);
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == 0);
    finish_job(&job, 0);
    check_reply(&fixture, &job, 510, 0);
    CHECK(job.call.token != tokens[0]);
    tokens[0] = job.call.token;
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == MB_MAP_SLOTS);

    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 52, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 52);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
    reply_empty(fixture.service, request.id, -ENOSPC);
    finish_job(&job, 0);
    check_empty(&job, -ENOSPC);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == MB_MAP_SLOTS);
    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < MB_MAP_SLOTS; ++i)
        free_token(fixture.client, tokens[i]);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE reply_slots=16 full=EAGAIN free_recovery=ok empty_full_reply=ok");
}

static void maximum_reply(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct job job;
    struct mb_buffer_request request;
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES], label[4072];
    size_t size;
    struct mb_transaction_reply reply = { .data = (uintptr_t)wire, .status = 7 };

    memset(label, 0xa5, sizeof(label));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_u32(&writer, 77, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_i32(&writer, 640, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, label, sizeof(label), 0, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, NULL, 0, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, NULL) && size == MB_MAX_PAYLOAD);
    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 64, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 64);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
    reply.id = request.id;
    reply.size = (uint32_t)size;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &reply) == 0);
    finish_job(&job, 0);
    CHECK(job.call.token && job.call.status == 7 && job.call.reply_size == size);
    CHECK(job.call.offset <= MB_MAP_BYTES - job.call.reply_size);
    CHECK(memcmp(fixture.reply_base + job.call.offset, wire, size) == 0);
    {
        struct mbp_reader reader;
        const unsigned char *view;
        uint32_t sequence;
        int32_t marker;
        size_t bytes, count;
        int is_null;

        CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, fixture.reply_base + job.call.offset, size, NULL));
        CHECK(mbp_read_u32(&reader, &sequence, NULL) && sequence == 77);
        CHECK(mbp_read_i32(&reader, &marker, NULL) && marker == 640);
        CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &bytes, &is_null, NULL));
        CHECK(!is_null && bytes == sizeof(label) && memcmp(view, label, bytes) == 0);
        CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, NULL, 0, &count, NULL) && count == 0);
        CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, NULL));
    }
    free_token(fixture.client, job.call.token);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE reply_max=4096 codec=validated reply_oversize=EINVAL");
}

static void cancellation_orders(void)
{
    struct fixture fixture;
    struct job job;
    struct mb_buffer_request request;
    struct mb_transaction_reply late = { 0 };

    open_fixture(&fixture, 0);
    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 71, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    CHECK(pthread_kill(job.thread, SIGUSR1) == 0);
    finish_job(&job, EINTR);
    await_counts(0, 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == 0);

    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 72, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 72);
    CHECK(pthread_kill(job.thread, SIGUSR1) == 0);
    finish_job(&job, EINTR);
    await_counts(0, 0);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).used_slots == 1);
    CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.client).used_slots == 0);
    late.id = request.id;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &late) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);

    start_job(&job, fixture.client, 73, 0);
    await_counts(1, 0);
    request = receive_request(&fixture, 73);
    free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
    reply_data(fixture.service, request.id, 730, 0);
    /* Successful REPLY is the explicit commit point before this signal. */
    CHECK(pthread_kill(job.thread, SIGUSR1) == 0);
    finish_job(&job, 0);
    check_reply(&fixture, &job, 730, 0);
    late.id = request.id;
    CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &late) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
    free_token(fixture.client, job.call.token);
    close_fixture(&fixture);
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE cancellation=queued,delivered orders=cancel_first,reply_first terminal_once=ok");
}

static struct child_server start_child_server(int client_fd)
{
    int commands[2], reports[2];
    struct child_server server;

    CHECK(pipe(commands) == 0 && pipe(reports) == 0);
    server.pid = fork();
    CHECK(server.pid >= 0);
    if (!server.pid) {
        int fd;
        const unsigned char *base;

        CHECK(close(commands[1]) == 0 && close(reports[0]) == 0);
        CHECK(close(observer) == 0 && close(client_fd) == 0);
        fd = open_device();
        base = map_region(fd);
        CHECK(ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_REGISTER_TRANSACTION) == 0);
        token_io(reports[1], 1);
        for (;;) {
            char command;
            transfer(commands[0], &command, 1, 0);
            if (command == 'R') {
                struct mb_buffer_request request;
                CHECK(ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_RECEIVE_TRANSACTION, &request) == 0);
                CHECK(request.size <= MB_MAX_PAYLOAD &&
                      request.offset <= MB_MAP_BYTES - request.size);
                CHECK(decode(base + request.offset, request.size) == 81);
                transfer(reports[1], &request, sizeof(request), 1);
            } else {
                CHECK(command == 'X');
                CHECK(munmap((void *)base, MB_MAP_BYTES) == 0 && close(fd) == 0);
                CHECK(close(commands[0]) == 0 && close(reports[1]) == 0);
                _exit(0);
            }
        }
    }
    active_child = server.pid;
    CHECK(close(commands[0]) == 0 && close(reports[1]) == 0);
    server.command = commands[1];
    server.report = reports[0];
    token_io(server.report, 0);
    return server;
}

static void server_exit_cases(void)
{
    for (int delivered = 0; delivered < 2; ++delivered) {
        int client = open_device(), status;
        const unsigned char *base = map_region(client);
        struct child_server server = start_child_server(client);
        struct job job;
        char command = 'R';

        start_job(&job, client, 81, 0);
        await_counts(1, 0);
        if (delivered) {
            struct mb_buffer_request request;
            transfer(server.command, &command, 1, 1);
            transfer(server.report, &request, sizeof(request), 0);
            CHECK(request.id > last_received_id && request.token != 0);
            last_received_id = request.id;
            await_counts(0, 1);
        }
        command = 'X';
        transfer(server.command, &command, 1, 1);
        CHECK(waitpid(server.pid, &status, 0) == server.pid);
        active_child = -1;
        CHECK(WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0);
        CHECK(close(server.command) == 0 && close(server.report) == 0);
        finish_job(&job, EPIPE);
        await_counts(0, 0);
        CHECK(buffer_stats(client).live_slots == 0);
        CHECK(munmap((void *)base, MB_MAP_BYTES) == 0 && close(client) == 0);
        clean_baseline();
    }
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE server_exit=queued,delivered errors=EPIPE resources=clean");
}

static void client_exit_cases(void)
{
    for (int delivered = 0; delivered < 2; ++delivered) {
        struct fixture fixture = { .client = -1, .reply_base = MAP_FAILED };
        struct mb_buffer_request request = { 0 };
        struct mb_buffer_stats buffers;
        struct mb_query query;
        pid_t child, waited;
        int status;

        fixture.service = open_device();
        fixture.request_base = map_region(fixture.service);
        CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REGISTER_TRANSACTION) == 0);
        child = fork();
        CHECK(child >= 0);
        if (!child) {
            unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES];
            struct mb_transaction_call call = { .data = (uintptr_t)wire };
            int fd;

            /* DONTCOPY omits the parent's VMA; drop inherited fd references. */
            CHECK(close(fixture.service) == 0 && close(observer) == 0);
            fd = open_device();
            (void)map_region(fd);
            call.size = (uint32_t)encode(wire, 91);
            (void)ioctl(fd, MB_IOC_CALL_TRANSACTION, &call);
            _exit(2);
        }
        active_child = child;
        await_counts(1, 0);
        if (delivered) {
            request = receive_request(&fixture, 91);
            await_counts(0, 1);
        }
        CHECK(kill(child, SIGKILL) == 0);
        do {
            waited = waitpid(child, &status, 0);
        } while (waited < 0 && errno == EINTR);
        CHECK(waited == child);
        active_child = -1;
        CHECK(WIFSIGNALED(status) && WTERMSIG(status) == SIGKILL);
        await_counts(0, 0);
        buffers = buffer_stats(fixture.service);
        CHECK(buffers.used_slots == (unsigned int)delivered);
        CHECK(buffers.live_slots == (unsigned int)delivered);
        CHECK(buffers.live_regions == 1 && buffers.mapped_vmas == 1);
        CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_QUERY, &query) == 0 && query.live_contexts == 2);
        if (delivered) {
            struct mb_transaction_reply late = { .id = request.id };
            CHECK(ioctl(fixture.service, MB_IOC_REPLY_TRANSACTION, &late) == -1 && errno == ENOENT);
            free_token(fixture.service, request.token);
        }
        CHECK(buffer_stats(fixture.service).live_slots == 0);
        CHECK(munmap((void *)fixture.request_base, MB_MAP_BYTES) == 0);
        CHECK(close(fixture.service) == 0);
        clean_baseline();
    }
    puts("TRANSACTION_STAGE client_SIGKILL=queued,delivered queued_auto_free=ok delivered_explicit_free=ok");
}

int main(void)
{
    struct sigaction action = { .sa_handler = deadline };
    struct mb_query query;

    _Static_assert(sizeof(struct mb_transaction_call) == 40, "transaction call ABI size");
    _Static_assert(sizeof(struct mb_transaction_reply) == 24, "transaction reply ABI size");
    owner = getpid();
    CHECK(atexit(cleanup) == 0);
    sigemptyset(&action.sa_mask);
    CHECK(sigaction(SIGALRM, &action, NULL) == 0);
    action.sa_handler = interrupted;
    action.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    CHECK(sigaction(SIGUSR1, &action, NULL) == 0);
    action.sa_handler = SIG_IGN;
    action.sa_flags = 0;
    CHECK(sigaction(SIGPIPE, &action, NULL) == 0);
    alarm(45);
    observer = open_device();
    CHECK(ioctl(observer, MB_IOC_QUERY, &query) == 0);
    CHECK(query.features & MB_FEATURE_TRANSACTION);
    clean_baseline();
    mode_and_input_errors();
    reverse_replies();
    reply_failures();
    reply_capacity();
    mapping_and_output_failures();
    maximum_reply();
    cancellation_orders();
    server_exit_cases();
    client_exit_cases();
    clean_baseline();
    CHECK(close(observer) == 0);
    observer = -1;
    alarm(0);
    puts("TRANSACTION_TEST_PASS reverse=2 reply_slots=16 cancellation=validated resources=clean");
    return 0;
}

import pathlib
import os
import select
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def read_ready_line(stream, timeout):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    data = bytearray()
    while b"\n" not in data:
        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise TimeoutError("incomplete readiness line")
        ready, _, _ = select.select([stream], [], [], remaining)
        if not ready:
            raise TimeoutError("incomplete readiness line")
        chunk = os.read(stream.fileno(), 4096)
        if not chunk:
            raise EOFError("server closed stdout before readiness line")
        data.extend(chunk)
        if len(data) > 4096:
            raise ValueError("readiness line exceeds 4096 bytes")
    return data.split(b"\n", 1)[0].decode("ascii")


class IntroExperiments(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_example(self, name, *args):
        binary = ROOT / "build" / name
        self.assertTrue(binary.is_file(), f"Missing experiment: {binary}")
        return subprocess.run([str(binary), *args], capture_output=True,
                              text=True, timeout=5)

    def test_local_call(self):
        result = self.run_example("local_add")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("result=3", result.stdout)

    def test_fork_does_not_share_result(self):
        result = self.run_example("fork_private")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("child result=3", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("parent result=-1", result.stdout)

    def test_rpc_executes_in_another_process(self):
        result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", "1", "2")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        fields = dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in result.stdout.split())
        self.assertEqual(fields["result"], "3")
        self.assertNotEqual(fields["client_pid"], fields["server_pid"])

    def test_rpc_other_arguments(self):
        for a, b, expected in [("0", "0", "0"), ("19", "23", "42"),
                               ("4294967295", "0", "4294967295")]:
            with self.subTest(a=a, b=b):
                result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", a, b)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                self.assertIn(f"result={expected}", result.stdout)

    def test_overflow_is_a_remote_error(self):
        result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", "4294967295", "1")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("remote error: overflow", result.stderr)

    def test_invalid_arguments(self):
        for value in ["-1", "4294967296", "abc", "", "1x"]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", value, "2")
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                self.assertIn("invalid argument", result.stderr)

    def test_server_exit_does_not_leave_client_waiting(self):
        result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", "1", "2", "--server-exit")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 3, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("transport error", result.stderr)

    def test_malformed_request_lengths_are_rejected(self):
        for option in ["--short-request", "--long-request"]:
            with self.subTest(option=option):
                result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", "1", "2", option)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 3, result.stderr)
                self.assertIn("server protocol error: malformed request", result.stderr)
                self.assertIn("transport error", result.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn("result=", result.stdout)

    def test_unknown_operation_is_a_remote_error(self):
        result = self.run_example("socket_rpc", "1", "2", "--unknown-op")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("remote error: unknown operation", result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("transport error", result.stderr)

    def test_live_server_without_reply_needs_harness_deadline(self):
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(ROOT / "build/socket_rpc"), "1", "2", "--server-no-reply"],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True,
            start_new_session=True)
        try:
            ready = read_ready_line(process.stdout, timeout=5)
            self.assertIn("event=request_received_no_reply", ready)
            fields = dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in ready.split())
            server_pid = int(fields["server_pid"])
            os.kill(server_pid, 0)
            self.assertNotRegex(pathlib.Path(f"/proc/{server_pid}/status").read_text(),
                                r"(?m)^State:\s+[ZX]")
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                process.communicate(timeout=0.2)
            self.assertIsNone(process.poll())
            os.kill(server_pid, 0)
            self.assertNotRegex(pathlib.Path(f"/proc/{server_pid}/status").read_text(),
                                r"(?m)^State:\s+[ZX]")
            process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=5)
            self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 124, stderr)
            self.assertIn("harness interruption: no protocol timeout", stderr)
            self.assertNotIn("transport error", stderr)
            self.assertNotIn("result=", stdout)
            with self.assertRaises(ProcessLookupError):
                os.kill(server_pid, 0)
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    process.communicate(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.communicate(timeout=5)
            process.stdout.close()
            process.stderr.close()

    def test_partial_readiness_line_times_out_and_cleans_up(self):
        self.assertTrue(callable(globals().get("read_ready_line")),
                        "missing bounded readiness reader")
        producer = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-c",
             "import os, signal; os.write(1, b'event=partial'); "
             "os.write(2, b'R'); signal.pause()"],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        reader = None
        try:
            ready, _, _ = select.select([producer.stderr], [], [], 5)
            self.assertTrue(ready, "partial-output producer did not start")
            self.assertEqual(os.read(producer.stderr.fileno(), 1), b"R")
            reader = subprocess.Popen(
                [sys.executable, "-c",
                 "import sys\nfrom test_intro import read_ready_line\n"
                 "try:\n    read_ready_line(sys.stdin, 0.1)\n"
                 "except TimeoutError:\n    print('event=readiness_timeout')\n"],
                cwd=ROOT / "tests", stdin=producer.stdout,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            stdout, stderr = reader.communicate(timeout=2)
            self.assertEqual(reader.returncode, 0, stderr)
            self.assertIn("event=readiness_timeout", stdout)
            self.assertIsNone(producer.poll())
        finally:
            for process in [reader, producer]:
                if process is None:
                    continue
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.terminate()
                try:
                    process.communicate(timeout=2)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.kill()
                    process.communicate(timeout=2)
        self.assertIsNotNone(producer.returncode)
        self.assertIsNotNone(reader.returncode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import pathlib
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class MappingModel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mini-binder-mapping-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.directory.cleanup)
        cls.binary = pathlib.Path(cls.directory.name) / "mapping"
        source = ROOT / "examples/memory/mapping.c"
        if not source.is_file():
            raise AssertionError(f"Missing mapping experiment: {source}")
        subprocess.run(
            ["cc", "-std=c11", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-pedantic", str(source), "-o", str(cls.binary)],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

    def run_model(self, *args, expected=0):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.binary), *args], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=8)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, expected, result.stderr)
        events = [dict(field.split("=", 1) for field in line.split())
                  for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
        return result, events

    def test_distinct_views_and_page_boundaries(self):
        _, events = self.run_model()
        views = next(e for e in events if e["event"] == "mapped")
        self.assertEqual(views["parent_prot"], "rw")
        self.assertEqual(views["child_prot"], "r")
        self.assertEqual(views["guards"], "none")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(int(views["bytes"]), 4096)
        self.assertNotEqual(int(views["parent_address"], 16), 0)
        self.assertNotEqual(int(views["child_address"], 16), 0)
        reads = [e for e in events if e["event"] == "read_ack"]
        self.assertEqual([(e["round"], e["first"], e["last"])
                          for e in reads], [("1", "7", "70"),
                                           ("2", "42", "420")])

    def test_close_precedes_both_handshakes_and_mapping_still_works(self):
        _, events = self.run_model()
        close = next(e for e in events if e["event"] == "fd_closed")
        self.assertEqual(close, {"event": "fd_closed", "parent": "1",
                                 "child": "1"})
        for round_number in ("1", "2"):
            published = next(e for e in events if e["event"] == "published"
                             and e["round"] == round_number)
            ack = next(e for e in events if e["event"] == "read_ack"
                       and e["round"] == round_number)
            self.assertLess(events.index(close), events.index(published))
            self.assertLess(events.index(published), events.index(ack))

    def test_ro_write_and_guard_read_fault_are_waited_and_checked(self):
        _, events = self.run_model()
        faults = [e for e in events if e["event"] == "fault"]
        self.assertEqual([(e["kind"], int(e["signal"])) for e in faults],
                         [("ro_write", signal.SIGSEGV),
                          ("guard_read", signal.SIGSEGV)])
        preserved = next(e for e in events if e["event"] == "preserved")
        self.assertEqual(preserved["first"], "42")
        self.assertEqual(preserved["last"], "420")
        self.assertEqual(events[-1], {"event": "cleanup", "children_reaped": "2",
                                      "unmapped": "1", "result": "ok"})

    def test_abort_reaps_reader_waiting_for_command(self):
        result, events = self.run_model("--abort-after-map", expected=1)
        self.assertIn("requested abort after map", result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(any(e["event"] == "read_ack" for e in events))
        self.assertEqual(events[-1], {"event": "cleanup", "children_reaped": "1",
                                      "unmapped": "1", "result": "failed"})

    def test_unknown_option_is_rejected_before_creating_resources(self):
        result, events = self.run_model("--unknown", expected=2)
        self.assertIn("usage:", result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(events, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import itertools
import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class NodeModel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mini-binder-node-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.directory.cleanup)
        cls.binary = pathlib.Path(cls.directory.name) / "nodes"
        source = ROOT / "examples/models/nodes.c"
        if not source.is_file():
            raise AssertionError(f"Missing node model: {source}")
        subprocess.run(["cc", "-std=c11", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
                        "-pedantic", str(source), "-o", str(cls.binary)],
                       check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

    def run_model(self, *arguments, expected=0):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.binary), *arguments], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=5)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, expected, result.stderr)
        rows = [dict(field.split("=", 1) for field in line.split())
                for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
        return result, rows

    def trace(self, *events):
        _, rows = self.run_model("trace", *events)
        steps = [row for row in rows if row["event"] == "step"]
        self.assertEqual([row["operation"] for row in steps], list(events))
        for row in steps:
            self.assert_ledger(row)
        return steps

    def assert_ledger(self, row):
        refs = sum(int(row[field]) for field in ("published", "tx_refs", "slot_refs"))
        self.assertEqual(int(row["refs"]), refs)
        self.assertEqual(int(row["live_nodes"]), int(refs != 0))
        self.assertEqual(int(row["node_allocs"]) - int(row["node_frees"]), int(refs != 0))
        self.assertEqual(row["tx_refs"], row["tx_live"])
        self.assertEqual(int(row["slot_refs"]), int(row["request"] != "NONE"))
        self.assertEqual(int(row["tx_acquires"]) - int(row["tx_releases"]), int(row["tx_refs"]))
        self.assertEqual(int(row["slot_acquires"]) - int(row["slot_releases"]), int(row["slot_refs"]))
        terminal = row["state"] in ("REPLIED", "FAILED")
        self.assertEqual(int(row["terminal_count"]), int(terminal))
        self.assertEqual(int(row["accepted"]), int(row["status"] == "OK"))
        if row["owner_alive"] == "0":
            self.assertEqual((row["published"], row["slot_refs"], row["local_alive"]),
                             ("0", "0", "0"))

    def test_method_number_alone_merges_two_counter_states(self):
        _, rows = self.run_model("method")
        calls = [row for row in rows if row["event"] == "method_call"]
        self.assertEqual([(r["object"], r["code"], r["expected"], r["observed"])
                          for r in calls],
                         [("A", "1", "1", "1"), ("B", "1", "1", "2"),
                          ("A", "1", "2", "3")])

    def test_registry_dispatches_same_method_to_independent_persistent_objects(self):
        _, rows = self.run_model("registry")
        calls = [r for r in rows if r["event"] == "result"]
        self.assertEqual([(r["node"], r["code"], r["status"], r["value"])
                          for r in calls],
                         [("101", "1", "OK", "1"), ("102", "1", "OK", "101"),
                          ("101", "1", "OK", "3"), ("102", "2", "OK", "101"),
                          ("103", "3", "OK", "42"), ("101", "999", "ENOSYS", "none")])
        published = [r for r in rows if r["event"] == "publish"]
        self.assertEqual([(r["cookie"], r["node"], r["created"]) for r in published],
                         [("11", "101", "1"), ("22", "102", "1"),
                          ("33", "103", "1"), ("11", "101", "0")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1], {"event": "summary", "live_nodes": "0",
                                    "published": "0", "local_active": "0"})

    def test_duplicate_publish_is_idempotent_and_wrong_owner_cannot_remove(self):
        steps = self.trace("publish", "publish", "wrong_remove", "remove", "remove")
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in steps], ["OK", "OK", "EPERM", "OK", "ENOENT"])
        self.assertTrue(all(r["node"] == "101" for r in steps))
        self.assertEqual(steps[1]["node_allocs"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(steps[-1]["refs"], "0")

    def test_transaction_and_request_slot_each_independently_block_remove(self):
        tx = self.trace("call", "deliver", "free_request", "remove", "reply", "remove",
                        "reap", "remove")
        self.assertEqual((tx[3]["status"], tx[3]["tx_refs"], tx[3]["slot_refs"]),
                         ("EBUSY", "1", "0"))
        self.assertEqual(tx[5]["status"], "EBUSY")
        self.assertEqual(tx[-1]["status"], "OK")
        slot = self.trace("call", "deliver", "reply", "reap", "remove", "free_request", "remove")
        self.assertEqual((slot[4]["status"], slot[4]["tx_refs"], slot[4]["slot_refs"]),
                         ("EBUSY", "0", "1"))
        self.assertEqual(slot[-1]["refs"], "0")

    def test_busy_remove_keeps_node_published_and_callable(self):
        steps = self.trace("call", "remove", "cancel", "reap", "call")
        self.assertEqual((steps[1]["status"], steps[1]["published"]), ("EBUSY", "1"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[-1]["status"], steps[-1]["state"]), ("OK", "QUEUED"))

    def test_queued_and_delivered_cancellation_have_different_slot_responsibilities(self):
        queued = self.trace("call", "cancel", "remove", "reap", "remove")
        delivered = self.trace("call", "deliver", "cancel", "reap", "remove", "free_request", "remove")
        self.assertEqual((queued[1]["state"], queued[1]["slot_refs"]), ("FAILED", "0"))
        self.assertEqual(queued[2]["status"], "EBUSY")
        self.assertEqual(queued[-1]["status"], "OK")
        self.assertEqual((delivered[4]["status"], delivered[4]["slot_refs"]), ("EBUSY", "1"))
        self.assertEqual(delivered[-1]["refs"], "0")

    def test_cookie_reuse_gets_new_id_and_rejects_old_target_and_descriptor(self):
        steps = self.trace("call", "deliver", "free_request", "reply", "reap", "remove",
                           "destroy", "publish", "call_stale", "local_begin")
        self.assertEqual((steps[7]["node"], steps[7]["cookie"], steps[7]["created"]),
                         ("102", "7", "1"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[8]["status"], steps[9]["status"]), ("ENOENT", "ESTALE"))
        self.assertEqual(steps[9]["descriptor_node"], "101")

    def test_local_activity_survives_kernel_release_and_prevents_local_destroy(self):
        steps = self.trace("call", "deliver", "local_begin", "free_request", "cancel",
                           "reap", "remove", "destroy", "publish", "local_end", "destroy", "publish")
        self.assertEqual((steps[6]["status"], steps[6]["refs"], steps[6]["local_active"]),
                         ("OK", "0", "1"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[7]["status"], steps[8]["status"]), ("EBUSY", "EBUSY"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[10]["status"], steps[11]["node"]), ("OK", "102"))

    def test_publication_fault_rolls_back_only_new_node_and_does_not_reuse_id(self):
        steps = self.trace("publish_fault", "remove", "destroy", "publish_fault", "publish")
        self.assertEqual((steps[0]["status"], steps[0]["node_allocs"], steps[0]["published"]),
                         ("EFAULT", "1", "1"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[3]["status"], steps[3]["live_nodes"], steps[3]["node_allocs"],
                          steps[3]["node_frees"]), ("EFAULT", "0", "2", "2"))
        self.assertEqual(steps[4]["node"], "103")

    def test_failed_request_publish_and_receive_output_preserve_reference_ledger(self):
        steps = self.trace("call_fault", "call", "receive_fault", "remove", "deliver")
        self.assertEqual((steps[0]["status"], steps[0]["refs"]), ("EFAULT", "1"))
        self.assertEqual((steps[2]["status"], steps[2]["state"], steps[2]["slot_refs"]),
                         ("EFAULT", "QUEUED", "1"))
        self.assertEqual(steps[3]["status"], "EBUSY")
        self.assertEqual(steps[-1]["state"], "DELIVERED")

    def test_owner_exit_preserves_only_orphan_transaction_reference_until_reap(self):
        for prefix in (("call",), ("call", "deliver"), ("call", "deliver", "reply")):
            with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):
                rows = self.trace(*prefix, "owner_exit", "call", "publish", "reap")
                exited = rows[len(prefix)]
                self.assertEqual((exited["owner_alive"], exited["published"], exited["tx_refs"],
                                  exited["slot_refs"], exited["live_nodes"]),
                                 ("0", "0", "1", "0", "1"))
                self.assertEqual(exited["state"], "REPLIED" if prefix[-1] == "reply" else "FAILED")
                self.assertEqual((rows[-3]["status"], rows[-2]["status"]), ("ENOENT", "EPIPE"))
                self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["live_nodes"], "0")

    def test_event_pairs_preserve_counts_and_terminal_monotonicity(self):
        events = ("deliver", "reply", "cancel", "reap", "free_request", "remove", "owner_exit")
        for pair in itertools.product(events, repeat=2):
            with self.subTest(pair=pair):
                rows = self.trace("call", *pair)
                terminal = None
                for row in rows:
                    if terminal:
                        self.assertEqual(row["state"], terminal)
                    elif row["state"] in ("REPLIED", "FAILED"):
                        terminal = row["state"]

    def test_local_dispatch_requires_a_delivered_matching_descriptor_and_one_activity(self):
        rows = self.trace("local_begin", "call", "deliver", "local_begin", "local_begin",
                          "local_end", "local_end")
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in rows],
                         ["ESTALE", "OK", "OK", "OK", "EBUSY", "OK", "ENOENT"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[4]["local_active"], "1")
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1]["local_active"], "0")

    def test_repeated_releases_and_terminal_events_do_not_change_reference_counts(self):
        rows = self.trace("call", "free_request", "deliver", "free_request", "free_request",
                          "reply", "cancel", "reply", "reap", "reap", "remove", "remove")
        self.assertEqual([rows[i]["status"] for i in (1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11)],
                         ["EBUSY", "ENOENT", "ENOENT", "ENOENT", "ENOENT", "ENOENT"])
        self.assertEqual((rows[-1]["terminal_count"], rows[-1]["node_frees"],
                          rows[-1]["tx_releases"], rows[-1]["slot_releases"]),
                         ("1", "1", "1", "1"))

    def test_cli_validates_all_arguments_before_producing_output(self):
        for args in ((), ("unknown",), ("method", "extra"), ("registry", "extra"),
                     ("trace",), ("trace", "call", "unknown")):
            result, rows = self.run_model(*args, expected=2)
            self.assertEqual(rows, [])
            self.assertIn("usage:", result.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
HARNESS = r'''
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "parcel.h"

#define CHECK(c) do { if (!(c)) { \
    fprintf(stderr, "library check line=%d error=%s\n", __LINE__, error ? error : "none"); \
    return 1; } } while (0)

static int roundtrip(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES], label[] = {0xff, 0, 0x80};
    int32_t input[] = {INT32_MIN, -1, 0, INT32_MAX}, output[4] = {0};
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const unsigned char *view;
    const char *error = NULL;
    size_t size, label_size, count;
    uint32_t u32;
    int32_t i32;
    int null;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_u32(&writer, UINT32_MAX, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_i32(&writer, INT32_MIN, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, label, sizeof(label), 0, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, input, 4, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error) && size == 44);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_u32(&reader, &u32, &error) && u32 == UINT32_MAX);
    CHECK(mbp_read_i32(&reader, &i32, &error) && i32 == INT32_MIN);
    CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &label_size, &null, &error));
    CHECK(view == wire + 20 && label_size == 3 && !null && !memcmp(view, label, 3));
    CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, output, 4, &count, &error));
    CHECK(count == 4 && !memcmp(input, output, sizeof(input)));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error));
    return 0;
}

static int header(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES] = {0};
    struct mbp_writer writer = {wire, 99, 77};
    struct mbp_reader reader = {wire, 99, 77};
    const char *error = NULL;
    CHECK(!mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, 7, &error) && writer.position == 77);
    CHECK(!mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, MBP_MAX_BYTES + 1, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_writer_init(&writer, NULL, 8, &error));
    CHECK(writer.data == wire && writer.capacity == 99 && writer.position == 77);
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(writer.position == 8 && !memcmp(wire, "MBP1\1\0\0\0", 8));
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, 7, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, MBP_MAX_BYTES + 1, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_init(&reader, NULL, 8, &error));
    wire[0] = 'X';
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, 8, &error) && !strcmp(error, "magic"));
    wire[0] = 'M';
    wire[4] = 2;
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, 8, &error) && !strcmp(error, "version"));
    CHECK(reader.data == wire && reader.size == 99 && reader.position == 77);
    return 0;
}

static int bytes(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[64], data[] = {1, 0, 255, 2, 3, 4, 5};
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const unsigned char *view;
    const char *error = NULL;
    size_t size, count;
    int null;
    for (unsigned int n = 0; n <= sizeof(data); ++n) {
        CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
        CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, data, n, 0, &error));
        CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error));
        CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
        CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &count, &null, &error));
        CHECK(view == wire + 12 && count == n && !null && !memcmp(view, data, n));
        CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error));
    }
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, NULL, 0, 1, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error) && size == 12);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &count, &null, &error));
    CHECK(view == NULL && count == 0 && null == 1);
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, data, 3, 0, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error));
    wire[15] = 1;
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    view = data;
    count = 99;
    null = 7;
    CHECK(!mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &count, &null, &error));
    CHECK(!strcmp(error, "padding") && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(view == data && count == 99 && null == 7);
    return 0;
}

static int array_capacity(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[64];
    int32_t input[] = {INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX};
    struct { uint32_t before; int32_t data[2]; uint32_t after; } output =
        {UINT32_C(0x12345678), {123, 456}, UINT32_C(0xabcdef01)};
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const char *error = NULL;
    size_t size, count = 77;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, input, 2, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_read_array(&reader, output.data, 1, &count, &error));
    CHECK(!strcmp(error, "capacity") && count == 77 && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(output.data[0] == 123 && output.data[1] == 456);
    CHECK(output.before == UINT32_C(0x12345678) && output.after == UINT32_C(0xabcdef01));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size - 1, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_read_array(&reader, output.data, 2, &count, &error));
    CHECK(output.data[0] == 123 && output.data[1] == 456 && count == 77 && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, output.data, 2, &count, &error));
    CHECK(count == 2 && !memcmp(input, output.data, sizeof(input)));
    CHECK(output.before == UINT32_C(0x12345678) && output.after == UINT32_C(0xabcdef01));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, NULL, 0, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, NULL, 0, &count, &error) && count == 0);
    return 0;
}

static int failure_cursors(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[64], value[] = {1, 2, 3};
    int32_t items[] = {1, 2}, signed_output = 123;
    uint32_t output = 123;
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const char *error = NULL;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, 11, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_u32(&writer, 1, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_write_i32(&writer, -1, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, 11, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_read_u32(&reader, &output, &error) && output == 123 && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_read_i32(&reader, &signed_output, &error) && signed_output == 123 && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, 15, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_bytes(&writer, value, 3, 0, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, 19, &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_array(&writer, items, 2, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_write_array(&writer, NULL, 1, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_write_bytes(&writer, NULL, 1, 0, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_write_bytes(&writer, NULL, 1, 1, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    return 0;
}

static int limits(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[MBP_MAX_BYTES], data[MBP_MAX_BYTES] = {0};
    int32_t values[MBP_MAX_BYTES / 4] = {0}, output[MBP_MAX_BYTES / 4];
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const unsigned char *view;
    const char *error = NULL;
    size_t size, count;
    int null;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_bytes(&writer, data, 4084, 0, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error) && size == MBP_MAX_BYTES);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_bytes(&reader, &view, &count, &null, &error) && count == 4084);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_bytes(&writer, data, 4085, 0, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_write_array(&writer, values, 1021, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error) && size == MBP_MAX_BYTES);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_array(&reader, output, 1024, &count, &error) && count == 1021);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), &error));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_array(&writer, values, 1022, &error) && writer.position == 8);
    CHECK(!mbp_write_bytes(&writer, data, SIZE_MAX, 0, &error) && !strcmp(error, "overflow"));
    CHECK(!mbp_write_array(&writer, values, SIZE_MAX / 4 + 1, &error) && !strcmp(error, "overflow"));
    CHECK(writer.position == 8);
    return 0;
}

static int unaligned(void)
{
    unsigned char storage[65];
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const char *error = NULL;
    size_t size;
    uint32_t value;
    int32_t signed_output;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, storage + 1, 64, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_u32(&writer, UINT32_C(0x12345678), &error));
    CHECK(mbp_write_i32(&writer, -7, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, storage + 1, size, &error));
    CHECK(mbp_read_u32(&reader, &value, &error) && value == UINT32_C(0x12345678));
    CHECK(mbp_read_i32(&reader, &signed_output, &error) && signed_output == -7);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error));
    return 0;
}

static int finish(void)
{
    unsigned char wire[64];
    struct mbp_writer writer;
    struct mbp_reader reader;
    const char *error = "unchanged";
    size_t size = 99;
    uint32_t value;
    CHECK(mbp_writer_init(&writer, wire, sizeof(wire), NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, &error) && size == 8);
    CHECK(!strcmp(error, "unchanged"));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, NULL));
    CHECK(!mbp_read_u32(&reader, &value, NULL) && reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_write_u32(&writer, 123, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_writer_finish(&writer, &size, NULL));
    CHECK(mbp_reader_init(&reader, wire, size, NULL));
    CHECK(!mbp_reader_finish(&reader, &error) && !strcmp(error, "trailing"));
    CHECK(reader.position == 8);
    CHECK(mbp_read_u32(&reader, &value, NULL) && value == 123);
    CHECK(mbp_reader_finish(&reader, NULL));
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    int result = 1;
    if (argc != 2)
        return 2;
    if (!strcmp(argv[1], "roundtrip")) result = roundtrip();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "header")) result = header();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "bytes")) result = bytes();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "array_capacity")) result = array_capacity();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "failure_cursors")) result = failure_cursors();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "limits")) result = limits();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "unaligned")) result = unaligned();
    else if (!strcmp(argv[1], "finish")) result = finish();
    if (!result) printf("PASS %s\n", argv[1]);
    return result;
}
'''


class ParcelLibrary(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):

import pathlib
import random
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MAGIC = b"MBP1"
LIMIT = 4096


def oracle(sequence, status, label, values):
    wire = MAGIC + struct.pack("<IIi", 1, sequence, status)
    if label is None:
        wire += struct.pack("<I", 0xFFFFFFFF)
    else:
        wire += struct.pack("<I", len(label)) + label
        wire += b"\0" * (-len(label) % 4)
    return wire + struct.pack("<I", len(values)) + b"".join(
        struct.pack("<i", value) for value in values)


class ParcelModel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mini-binder-parcel-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.directory.cleanup)
        cls.binary = pathlib.Path(cls.directory.name) / "parcel"
        source = ROOT / "examples/models/parcel.c"
        if not source.is_file():
            raise AssertionError(f"Missing parcel model: {source}")
        subprocess.run(
            ["cc", "-std=c11", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-pedantic", "-I", str(ROOT / "userspace"), str(source),
             str(ROOT / "userspace/parcel.c"), "-o", str(cls.binary)],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

    def invoke(self, *arguments, expected=0):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.binary), *arguments], text=True,
                                capture_output=True, timeout=5)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, expected, result.stderr)
        return result

    def decoded(self, sequence, status, label, values):
        return {"sequence": str(sequence), "status": str(status),
                "label": "null" if label is None else label.hex(),
                "values": ",".join(map(str, values))}

    def parse(self, output):
        return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in output.splitlines())

    def reject(self, wire, reason=None):
        result = self.invoke("decode", wire.hex(), expected=1)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
        self.assertIn("error=", result.stderr)
        if reason:
            self.assertIn("error=" + reason, result.stderr)

    def test_demo_matches_independent_wire_oracle(self):
        fields = (0x12345678, -7, b"A\0B", [1, -2, 2147483647, -2147483648])
        output = self.parse(self.invoke("demo").stdout)
        self.assertEqual(output.pop("hex"), oracle(*fields).hex())
        self.assertEqual(output, self.decoded(*fields))

    def test_raw_struct_copies_pointer_values_and_keeps_aliases(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.parse(self.invoke("raw").stdout),
                         {"same_label_pointer": "1", "same_array_pointer": "1",
                          "raw_label_before": "410042", "raw_label_after": "5a0042",
                          "raw_array_after": "99,-2", "wire_label": "410042",
                          "wire_values": "1,-2"})

    def test_encode_and_decode_against_independent_oracle(self):
        cases = [(0, 0, None, []), (0xFFFFFFFF, -2147483648, b"", []),
                 (1, 2147483647, b"\xff\x00\x80", [-1, 0, 1])]
        rng = random.Random(20261106)
        for _ in range(24):
            cases.append((rng.randrange(2**32), rng.randrange(-2**31, 2**31),
                          bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randrange(17))),
                          [rng.randrange(-2**31, 2**31) for _ in range(rng.randrange(9))]))
        for sequence, status, label, values in cases:
            with self.subTest(sequence=sequence, label=label, values=values):
                wire = oracle(sequence, status, label, values)
                encoded = self.parse(self.invoke(
                    "encode", str(sequence), str(status),
                    "null" if label is None else label.hex(),
                    ",".join(map(str, values))).stdout)
                self.assertEqual(encoded, {"hex": wire.hex()})
                output = self.parse(self.invoke("decode", wire.hex()).stdout)
                self.assertEqual(output, self.decoded(sequence, status, label, values))

    def test_null_empty_embedded_nul_and_non_utf8_remain_distinct(self):
        for label in (None, b"", b"\0", b"A\0B", b"\xff\xfe"):
            with self.subTest(label=label):
                wire = oracle(1, -1, label, [])
                self.assertEqual(self.parse(self.invoke("decode", wire.hex()).stdout),
                                 self.decoded(1, -1, label, []))
        self.assertNotEqual(oracle(1, 0, None, []), oracle(1, 0, b"", []))

    def test_every_proper_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        wire = oracle(0x12345678, -7, b"A\0B", [1, -2, 2147483647, -2147483648])
        for length in range(len(wire)):
            with self.subTest(length=length):
                self.reject(wire[:length])

    def test_bad_header_padding_lengths_counts_and_trailing_bytes(self):
        wire = oracle(7, -3, b"abc", [1, 2])
        self.reject(b"NOPE" + wire[4:], "magic")
        for version in (0, 2, 0xFFFFFFFF):
            self.reject(wire[:4] + struct.pack("<I", version) + wire[8:], "version")
        self.reject(wire[:23] + b"\x01" + wire[24:], "padding")
        for length in (4097, 0x40000000, 0xFFFFFFFE):
            self.reject(wire[:16] + struct.pack("<I", length) + wire[20:])
        for count in (1025, 0x40000000, 0xFFFFFFFF):
            self.reject(wire[:24] + struct.pack("<I", count) + wire[28:])
        self.reject(wire + b"\0", "trailing")
        self.reject(wire + b"\0" * 4, "trailing")
        self.reject(wire + b"\0" * LIMIT, "limit")

    def test_exact_payload_limit_for_bytes_and_arrays(self):
        for label, values in ((b"x" * 4072, []), (None, [1] * 1018)):
            wire = oracle(1, -1, label, values)
            self.assertEqual(len(wire), LIMIT)
            encoded = self.parse(self.invoke("encode", "1", "-1",
                                             "null" if label is None else label.hex(),
                                             ",".join(map(str, values))).stdout)
            self.assertEqual(encoded["hex"], wire.hex())
            self.assertEqual(self.parse(self.invoke("decode", wire.hex()).stdout),
                             self.decoded(1, -1, label, values))
        for label, values in ((b"x" * 4073, []), (None, [1] * 1019)):
            result = self.invoke("encode", "1", "-1",
                                 "null" if label is None else label.hex(),
                                 ",".join(map(str, values)), expected=1)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
            self.assertIn("error=limit", result.stderr)

    def test_failed_primitive_and_message_cursors_do_not_advance(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.parse(self.invoke("selftest").stdout),
                         {"cursor_checks": "10", "overflow_checks": "4"})

    def test_invalid_cli_values_and_hex_are_rejected_without_output(self):
        for value in ("0", "gg", "0x00", "00 00"):
            result = self.invoke("decode", value, expected=1)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
            self.assertIn("error=hex", result.stderr)
        for arguments in (("4294967296", "0", "", ""),
                          ("-1", "0", "", ""),
                          ("0", "2147483648", "", ""),
                          ("0", "-2147483649", "", ""),
                          ("0", "0", "", "1,"),
                          ("0", "0", "", "1,,2"),
                          ("0", "0", "", "2147483648")):
            self.assertEqual(self.invoke("encode", *arguments, expected=1).stdout, "")
        self.assertIn("usage:", self.invoke("unknown", expected=2).stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import pathlib
import signal
import subprocess
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class ProcessExperiments(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_example(self, name, *args):
        binary = ROOT / "build" / name
        self.assertTrue(binary.is_file(), f"Missing experiment: {binary}")
        return subprocess.run([str(binary), *args], capture_output=True,
                              text=True, timeout=5)

    def test_join_makes_worker_write_visible(self):
        result = self.run_example("thread_shared")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        lines = [dict(field.split("=", 1) for field in line.split())
                 for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual([line["event"] for line in lines],
                         ["before_create", "worker_write", "after_join"])
        self.assertEqual([line["result"] for line in lines], ["-1", "3", "3"])
        self.assertEqual(len({line["address"] for line in lines}), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len({line["pid"] for line in lines}), 1)

    def test_exit_status_is_not_a_full_integer_return(self):
        result = self.run_example("fork_status", "--exit")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("child_result=300", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("event=exited exit_status=44 parent_result=-1", result.stdout)

    def test_signal_termination_is_reported_and_reaped(self):
        result = self.run_example("fork_status", "--signal")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(f"event=signaled signal={signal.SIGTERM} parent_result=-1",
                      result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn("event=exited", result.stdout)

    def test_status_experiment_rejects_unknown_mode(self):
        result = self.run_example("fork_status", "--unknown")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("usage:", result.stderr)

    def test_fork_failure_uses_process_local_resource_limit(self):
        result = self.run_example("fork_failure")
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn("event=fork_rejected errno=11 child_created=0", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import pathlib
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class QueueModel(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="mini-binder-model-")
        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.directory.cleanup)
        cls.binary = pathlib.Path(cls.directory.name) / "request_queue"
        source = ROOT / "examples/models/request_queue.c"
        if not source.is_file():
            raise AssertionError(f"Missing queue model: {source}")
        subprocess.run(
            ["cc", "-std=c11", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-pedantic", str(source), "-o", str(cls.binary)],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

    def run_model(self, mode):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.binary), mode], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=5)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return [dict(field.split("=", 1) for field in line.split())
                for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]

    def test_overwrite_loses_first_clients_request(self):
        events = self.run_model("overwrite")
        lost = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "overwritten"]
        self.assertEqual(lost, [{"event": "overwritten", "request_id": "101",
                                 "client": "1"}])
        results = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "client_result"]
        self.assertEqual(results, [{"event": "client_result", "client": "2",
                                    "request_id": "102", "result": "42"}])

    def test_refusal_preserves_first_request_and_requires_retry(self):
        events = self.run_model("refuse")
        refused = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "refused"]
        self.assertEqual(refused, [{"event": "refused", "request_id": "102",
                                    "reason": "slot_full"}])
        self.assertLess(events.index(refused[0]),
                        next(i for i, event in enumerate(events)
                             if event["event"] == "retry"))
        results = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "client_result"]
        self.assertEqual([(event["client"], event["request_id"], event["result"])
                          for event in results], [("1", "101", "3"),
                                                 ("2", "102", "42")])

    def test_fifo_delivery_keeps_results_associated_when_replies_reverse(self):
        events = self.run_model("fifo")
        delivered = [event["request_id"] for event in events
                     if event["event"] == "delivered"]
        self.assertEqual(delivered, ["101", "102"])
        results = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "client_result"]
        self.assertEqual([(event["client"], event["request_id"], event["result"])
                          for event in results], [("2", "102", "42"),
                                                 ("1", "101", "3")])

    def test_fifo_rejects_full_queue_and_invalid_reply_ids(self):
        events = self.run_model("fifo")
        refused = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "refused"]
        self.assertEqual(refused, [{"event": "refused", "request_id": "103",
                                    "reason": "queue_full"}])
        rejected = [event for event in events if event["event"] == "reply_rejected"]
        self.assertEqual(rejected, [
            {"event": "reply_rejected", "request_id": "999", "reason": "unknown"},
            {"event": "reply_rejected", "request_id": "101", "reason": "not_delivered"},
            {"event": "reply_rejected", "request_id": "102", "reason": "duplicate"},
        ])

    def test_unknown_mode_is_rejected(self):
        result = subprocess.run([str(self.binary), "bogus"], capture_output=True,
                                text=True, timeout=5)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("usage:", result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
